headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that administrative supervision does not preclude the director from initiating judicial conservation, rehabilitation, or liquidation proceedings.

headings.title: Director authority to adopt supervision rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to adopt reasonable rules necessary to implement administrative supervision.

headings.title: Private meetings with administrative supervisor and counsel
headings.reviewNote: Permits the director to meet privately with the administrative supervisor and the supervisor's attorney or representative during proceedings.

headings.title: Immunity of director and administrative supervisor
headings.reviewNote: Grants absolute immunity to director, supervisor, and department employees for acts under administrative supervision.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes administrative orders, civil actions, license revocation for willful violations, and level four penalties for delinquency act violations.

headings.title: Administrative orders, level four penalties, and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes section 374.046 administrative orders, classifies violations of sections 375.1150 to 375.1246 as level four violations under section 374.049, and permits license or certificate suspension or revocation for willful violations.

headings.title: Civil actions for delinquency act violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to maintain civil actions for relief under section 374.048 and classifies violations as level four violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes ex parte judicial seizure orders for emergency asset control, specifying order duration, vacation, and records integrity.

headings.title: Director petition for ex parte seizure order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to petition circuit court for ex parte seizure order upon imminent danger of irreparable loss.

headings.title: Court issuance and scope of seizure order
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to issue seizure order vesting director with immediate possession of insurer property and records.

headings.title: Seizure order duration, modification, and vacation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to set order duration, allows modification hearings, requires vacating the order if formal proceedings are not timely commenced, and vacates it upon a formal proceeding order.

headings.title: Seizure order not an anticipatory breach
headings.reviewNote: Provides that entry of a seizure order does not constitute an anticipatory breach of any contract of the insurer.

headings.title: Insurer petition for hearing within fifteen days
headings.reviewNote: Allows an insurer subject to an ex parte seizure order to petition at any time for a hearing and review, which the court must hold within 15 days.

headings.title: Notice to substantially affected non-appearing persons
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to order notice to substantially affected persons who did not appear and were not served, without staying prior orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Designates director as rehabilitator, detailing title to assets, periodic court accounting, and qualified immunity protections.

headings.title: Director appointment and title as rehabilitator
headings.reviewNote: Directs court order to appoint director as rehabilitator and vest title to all insurer property and assets in director.

headings.title: Semiannual court accountings and plan timetable
headings.reviewNote: Requires rehabilitator accountings to the court at least semiannually, including an opinion and timetable regarding preparation of a section 375.1168(4) rehabilitation plan.

headings.title: No anticipatory breach or retroactive contract cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a rehabilitation order is not an anticipatory breach or grounds for retroactive contract revocation or cancellation unless made by the rehabilitator under section 375.1168.

headings.title: Qualified immunity for rehabilitator and deputies
headings.reviewNote: Provides official immunity from civil liability for rehabilitator, special deputies, and employees acting in good faith.

entries.reviewSummary: Empowers rehabilitator to appoint special deputies, manage insurer operations, pursue legal remedies for misconduct, propose rehabilitation plans, avoid fraudulent transfers, and appoint an advisory committee.

headings.title: Appointment and powers of special deputies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rehabilitator to appoint special deputies, counsel, and experts to manage rehabilitation operations.

headings.title: General operational powers of rehabilitator
headings.reviewNote: Grants rehabilitator full authority over insurer contracts, property, employees, and legal proceedings.

headings.title: Pursuit of legal remedies for officer misconduct
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the rehabilitator to pursue all appropriate legal remedies on behalf of the insurer when criminal or tortious conduct or breach of contractual or fiduciary obligation appears detrimental to the insurer.

headings.title: Submission of plan of rehabilitation to court
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rehabilitator to prepare and submit plan of rehabilitation, reorganization, or policy moratoria to court.

headings.title: Avoidance of fraudulent transfers in rehabilitation
headings.reviewNote: Vests rehabilitator with all legal powers to avoid fraudulent transfers and obligations under state law.

headings.title: Appointment of creditor advisory committee
headings.reviewNote: Allows rehabilitator with court approval to appoint an unpaid advisory committee of policyholders and creditors.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides mandatory ninety-day stay of pending actions upon rehabilitation order, tolls limitations periods, and grants guaranty standing.

headings.title: Ninety-day stay of actions against insurer
headings.reviewNote: Requires Missouri courts to stay pending actions involving insurer for ninety days upon entry of rehabilitation order.

headings.title: Tolling of statutes of limitation and laches
headings.reviewNote: Tolls statutes of limitations and laches during rehabilitation petition pendency and extends claimant filing windows.

headings.title: Standing of guaranty associations in rehabilitation
headings.reviewNote: Grants Missouri and foreign guaranty associations standing to appear in court proceedings concerning insurer rehabilitation.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs director petition to convert rehabilitation to liquidation, mandatory insolvency petition, and termination of rehabilitation.

headings.title: Petition for liquidation upon futile rehabilitation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to petition for liquidation when further rehabilitation attempts would be futile or increase loss risk.

headings.title: Mandatory liquidation petition upon suspended payments
headings.reviewNote: Requires rehabilitator to petition for liquidation if policy payments are substantially suspended for six months without plan.

headings.title: Petition to terminate rehabilitation and restore business
headings.reviewNote: Allows rehabilitator or insurer directors to petition court to terminate rehabilitation and restore control of business.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory grounds for judicial insurer liquidation and conditions for voluntary corporate dissolution of stock insurers.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for insurer liquidation petition
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates liquidation grounds including insolvency, hazardous condition, failure to meet charter standards, or business cessation.

headings.title: Conditions for voluntary dissolution of stock insurer
headings.reviewNote: Permits stock insurer voluntary dissolution under chapter 351 upon director approval, claim satisfaction, and exam completion.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs appointment of director as liquidator, special deputies, title vesting, notice recording, appeal plans, and interference penalties.

headings.title: Appointment of director as liquidator and title
headings.reviewNote: Vests director as liquidator with title to all insurer property, contracts, books, and records upon entry of order.

headings.title: Appointment and powers of special deputies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director with court approval to appoint non-department special deputies with full liquidator powers.

headings.title: Fixing of rights, tolled limitations, and shareholder stay
headings.reviewNote: Fixes insurer, creditor, policyholder, and shareholder rights and liabilities as of the liquidation order, suspends statutes of limitations except under specified sections, and suspends external shareholder rights.

headings.title: Scope of liquidation for domiciled alien insurers
headings.reviewNote: Gives a liquidation order for a Missouri-domiciled alien insurer the same effect as for a domestic insurer, limited to United States assets and business.

headings.title: Petition for judicial declaration of insolvency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director, upon determining insolvency, to petition the court for a judicial declaration of insolvency after notice and hearing.

headings.title: Annual financial reports, reserve filings, and reinsurer security
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual court financial reports and annual liquidator reserve statements to the director, obligates reinsurers to post required letters of credit or security, and authorizes barring noncompliant reinsurers from Missouri domestic insurers.

headings.title: Appeal pendency plan for continued claims performance
headings.reviewNote: Requires submitting a court-approved plan within five days of an appeal to continue policy claims and defense obligations (granting preference immunity), preserves guaranty association duties, and requires pro rata adjustments and full repayment if reversed.

headings.title: Class D felony for interfering with records or property
headings.reviewNote: Makes knowingly destroying, concealing, converting, altering, or refusing to deliver insurer records or property after a liquidation order a class D felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates policy termination dates upon liquidation, thirty-day continuation, guaranty coverage transitions, and life insurance terms.

headings.title: Continuation of life, health, and annuity policies
headings.reviewNote: Continues life, health, and annuity policies in force for the period and terms provided by any applicable guaranty association or foreign guaranty association.

headings.title: Termination of uncovered life, health, and annuity policies
headings.reviewNote: Provides that life, health, or annuity policies or coverages not covered by a guaranty association terminate under subsections 3 and 4.

headings.title: Termination rules for non-life and non-health policies
headings.reviewNote: Continues other policies (including bonds and noncancelable business) only for the lesser of 30 days, coverage expiration, insured replacement, transfer under section 375.1182(1)(8), or court-approved cancellation date.

headings.title: Superseding effect of liquidation coverage termination
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that a section 375.1176 liquidation order terminates coverages at the time specified in subsection 1 notwithstanding any other law.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates extensive operational powers of liquidator, extended reporting endorsements, and status as court officers.

headings.title: Statutory operational powers of liquidator
headings.reviewNote: Grants liquidator comprehensive authority to collect assets, manage property, prosecute suits, and settle claims.

headings.title: Extended claims reporting period for claims-made policies
headings.reviewNote: Allows the liquidator within 60 days to offer an extended reporting period (up to the earlier of claim bar date or 18 months) for court-approved charge to claims-made insureds without substitute coverage, deemed rejected if not accepted and paid within 90 days.

headings.title: Non-limitation of enumerated liquidator powers
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that enumerating liquidator powers does not limit or exclude other acts necessary or appropriate to accomplish liquidation.

headings.title: No obligation to defend claims after discharge
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the liquidator has no obligation to defend or continue defending claims after being discharged.

headings.title: Court-officer status and absolute judicial immunity
headings.reviewNote: Deems the liquidator, special deputies, staff, and state employees officers of the court subject to court orders and grants them absolute judicial immunity for acts or omissions in liquidation duties.

headings.title: Retroactive application of deposit and investment standards
headings.reviewNote: Applies subsection 1(16) deposit and investment standards to delinquency proceedings commenced both before and after August 28, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs reinsurance contracts of insurers placed in conservation, rehabilitation, or liquidation, and guaranty fund assumptions.

headings.title: Reinsurance contracts during conservation or rehabilitation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that life, health, or annuity reinsurance contracts of ceding insurers in conservation or rehabilitation continue or terminate per contract terms and this section.

headings.title: Continuation of life and health reinsurance upon liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Continues life, health, or annuity reinsurance contracts after liquidation unless previously terminated by their terms or terminated by the liquidation order (triggering subsection 9).

headings.title: Guaranty association 180-day election to assume reinsurance
headings.reviewNote: Allows a guaranty association within 180 days of liquidation to assume life, health, or annuity reinsurance contracts retroactive to liquidation, governing record access, unpaid premiums, 30/35-day balance settlement, and 60-day payment protections.

headings.title: Receiver 180-day election for uncovered continued policies
headings.reviewNote: Allows a receiver continuing uncovered life, health, or annuity policies to assume related reinsurance contracts within 180 days, charging premiums as class 1 administrative expenses and directing loss payments to the estate.

headings.title: Suspension of rights and obligations pending election
headings.reviewNote: Suspends rights and obligations of the guaranty association, receiver, and reinsurer under eligible reinsurance contracts from the liquidation order until election.

headings.title: Effect of timely assumption versus retroactive termination
headings.reviewNote: Applies subsection 3 or 4 upon timely election, and retroactively terminates unassumed reinsurance contracts as of the liquidation order date subject to subsection 9.

headings.title: Transfer of assumed reinsurance to assuming insurer
headings.reviewNote: Permits transferring assumed reinsurance contracts along with policies to an assuming insurer upon at least 30 days written notice, excluding new policies unless agreed.

headings.title: Post-liquidation versus pre-liquidation reinsurance proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Supersedes contrary laws or contracts for post-liquidation proceeds while preserving the receiver's right to pre-liquidation loss proceeds subject to setoff.

headings.title: Mandatory valuation, negotiation, and arbitration on termination
headings.reviewNote: Establishes 30-day actuary appointment, 90-day exchange and negotiation, arbitration procedures, Federal Arbitration Act confirmation, and settlement payment or class 5 priority under section 375.1218(5) (source note: original rolls state 'subsection 5').

headings.title: Preserved rights and property-casualty reinsurance exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Preserves contract terms, rescission rights, and guaranty creditor rights; creates no independent policyholder cause of action against reinsurers; and excludes property and casualty reinsurance.

headings.title: Harmonious construction with guaranty association law
headings.reviewNote: Requires construing this section and section 376.734(1)(10) consistently with each other and with the purpose of section 376.715.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes liquidator to affirm or disaffirm executory contracts and unexpired leases, setting liability measures and claim deadlines.

headings.title: Liquidator authority to disaffirm burdensome contracts or leases
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the liquidator to disaffirm or repudiate any insurer contract or lease determined in the liquidator's sole discretion to be burdensome and whose repudiation promotes orderly administration.

headings.title: Timing and effective date of contract repudiation
headings.reviewNote: Requires deciding within a reasonable period after the liquidation order, with repudiation effective as of the liquidation order date or a subsequent date selected by the liquidator.

headings.title: Actual direct compensatory damages limit on repudiation
headings.reviewNote: Limits liquidator repudiation liability to actual direct compensatory damages as of repudiation date (excluding punitive damages, lost profits or opportunity, and pain and suffering), submitted under sections 375.1206 to 375.1222.

headings.title: Formalities required for asset-diminishing agreements
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates agreements diminishing or defeating the liquidator's interest in insurer assets unless written, contemporaneously executed, approved in board minutes, and continuously maintained as official insurer records.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates mandatory liquidation notices to regulators, guaranty associations, agents, and policyholders, guaranty coverage disclosures, and liquidator cooperation with guaranty associations.

headings.title: Mandatory recipients of liquidation notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires liquidator to give notice of liquidation order to insurance commissioners, guaranty funds, agents, and insureds.

headings.title: Guaranty association coverage notice to agents and policyholders
headings.reviewNote: Requires subsection 1 notices to agents and policyholder claimants to include notice that state guaranty association coverage may be available for all or part of policy benefits.

headings.title: Liquidator cooperation and policyholder data for guaranty associations
headings.reviewNote: Directs the liquidator to promptly provide policyholder identities, addresses, and policy coverages to guaranty associations and cooperate in giving timely coverage notices.

entries.reviewSummary: Imposes duty on agents to provide notice and policyholder information to liquidator, establishing monetary penalties.

headings.title: Agent duty to supply policy records to liquidator
headings.reviewNote: Requires agents receiving section 375.1185 liquidation notice to provide policy, subagent, premium, and earned/unearned commission records to the liquidator within 30 days.

headings.title: Daily administrative penalty and license suspension
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes after hearing an administrative penalty up to $1,000 per day of refusal (deposited to general revenue) and suspension of department licenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes automatic stay of lawsuits against insurer or liquidator, intervention rights, and extensions of limitation periods.

headings.title: Automatic stay of actions upon liquidation order
headings.reviewNote: Bars commencement or prosecution of any action against insurer or liquidator upon liquidation order.

headings.title: Ten-year limitation extension for liquidator estate actions
headings.reviewNote: Grants the liquidator 10 years (or longer applicable period) after a liquidation order to bring unexpired estate actions and stays contractual or procedural deadlines for 10 years.

headings.title: Tolling of limitations between petition filing and denial
headings.reviewNote: Tolls statutes of limitation and laches against an insurer between liquidation petition filing and denial, allowing at least 60 days after denial to commence actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires liquidator to prepare and file a duplicate asset list within 120 days, authorizes reducing assets to liquidity, and accepts early-access disbursement filings as compliance.

headings.title: Preparation and court filing of asset inventory
headings.reviewNote: Requires liquidator to prepare and file with court a complete inventory of insurer property and assets.

headings.title: Authority to reduce assets to appropriate liquidity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the liquidator to reduce insurer assets to a degree of liquidity consistent with effective execution of the liquidation.

headings.title: Early-access disbursement filing satisfies inventory duty
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a court submission for asset disbursement under section 375.1205 fulfills the subsection 1 asset-list requirement.

entries.reviewSummary: Protects contractual rights under netting agreements and qualified financial contracts from stay or avoidance in delinquency.

headings.title: Protection of rights under netting agreements
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits staying or enjoining counterparty rights to terminate, liquidate, or net qualified financial contracts.

headings.title: Net settlement payment to receiver despite walkaway clauses
headings.reviewNote: Requires transferring net settlement amounts owed by nondefaulting parties to the receiver notwithstanding walkaway clauses, defines walkaway clause, and converts limited two-way provisions to full two-way.

headings.title: All-or-nothing rule for receiver contract transfers
headings.reviewNote: Requires a receiver transferring netting agreements or qualified financial contracts to transfer either all or none of the agreements, rights, obligations, and collateral for a counterparty and its affiliates.

headings.title: Next-business-day noon notice of contract transfer
headings.reviewNote: Directs the receiver to use best efforts to notify parties of a transfer by noon receiver's local time on the next business day, defining business day.

headings.title: Bar on avoiding pre-petition transfers absent actual fraud
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits avoiding pre-petition transfers or collateral arrangements under netting agreements or qualified financial contracts unless made with actual intent to hinder, delay, or defraud.

headings.title: All-or-nothing disaffirmance and compensatory damages calculation
headings.reviewNote: Requires disaffirming all or none of a counterparty's and affiliates' contracts, treats resulting claims as pre-petition, and limits damages to actual direct compensatory damages including reasonable cover costs (source note: 'does' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Definition of contractual right for financial contracts
headings.reviewNote: Defines contractual right to include rules of derivatives clearing organizations and securities market customs.

headings.title: Exclusion of insurer affiliates from netting protections
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that section protections do not apply to counterparties who are affiliates of the insurer.

headings.title: Application to separate accounts and general account
headings.reviewNote: Applies counterparty rights to netting agreements entered on behalf of general or separate accounts.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates avoidance of fraudulent transfers made within one year prior to petition, perfection standards, and transferee liability.

headings.title: Avoidance of fraudulent transfers made without consideration
headings.reviewNote: Allows receiver to avoid transfers within one year of petition made without fair consideration or with fraudulent intent.

headings.title: Perfection standards for real and personal property
headings.reviewNote: Defines when real and personal property transfers are deemed perfected against judicial lien creditors and purchasers.

headings.title: Fraudulent transfers in reinsurance contract commutations
headings.reviewNote: Deems reinsurance adjustments releasing reinsurer obligations within one year fraudulent unless fair value given.

headings.title: Personal liability of transferee to account
headings.reviewNote: Imposes personal liability on recipient of fraudulent transfer to account to liquidator for property received.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs validity of post-petition transfers of real and personal property, good faith defenses, and negotiability protections.

headings.title: Post-petition transfers of real property to purchasers
headings.reviewNote: Validates post-petition real property transfer to good faith purchaser for fair value before recording in county.

headings.title: Post-petition transfers of personal property and debts
headings.reviewNote: Governs post-petition transfers of personal property before receiver takes possession and good faith debt payments.

headings.title: Personal liability of post-petition transfer recipient
headings.reviewNote: Imposes personal liability on recipient of invalid post-petition property to account to liquidator upon contempt.

headings.title: Negotiability of currency and commercial instruments
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that delinquency provisions do not impair negotiability of currency or negotiable instruments.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates voidable preferences granted to creditors, four-month and one-year lookbacks, judicial liens, and officer personal liability.

headings.title: Definition and avoidance of voidable preferences
headings.reviewNote: Defines preference as pre-petition transfer on antecedent debt and empowers liquidator to avoid preferential transfers.

headings.title: Perfection rules for determining transfer timing
headings.reviewNote: Establishes perfection rules for real and personal property in determining whether transfer occurred within lookback.

headings.title: Definitions of judicial liens and superior rights
headings.reviewNote: Defines liens obtainable by legal or equitable proceedings on a simple contract and specifies when such liens or purchases become superior under subsection 2.

headings.title: Twenty-one-day perfection safe harbor and future loans
headings.reviewNote: Treats transfers for new contemporaneous consideration perfected within 21 days (or shorter statutory period) and transfers securing actual future loans as contemporaneous rather than antecedent debt.

headings.title: Voidability of surety-indemnifying transfers or liens
headings.reviewNote: Deems transfers or liens indemnifying a surety on a bond that dissolved a voidable lien under subsection 1(2) to also be voidable.

headings.title: Discharge of voidable liens and estate preservation
headings.reviewNote: Discharges property from voidable liens, vests affected and surety-indemnifying property in the liquidator, and authorizes court orders preserving liens for the estate.

headings.title: Summary jurisdiction, valuation, and retention by payment
headings.reviewNote: Grants the court summary jurisdiction with notice to interested parties and bond obligees, and lets transferees or lienholders retain indemnifying property or liens by paying court-ascertained value.

headings.title: Discharge of surety liability on releasing bonds
headings.reviewNote: Discharges a surety's liability under a releasing bond to the extent of indemnifying property recovered, liens avoided, or value paid under subsection 7.

headings.title: Court review of pre-petition payments to attorneys
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court examination of payments or transfers to attorneys within four months before liquidation or in contemplation of liquidation, allowing recovery of amounts exceeding reasonable value (insider attorneys governed by sub 1(2)(d)).

headings.title: Personal liability of participating insiders and recipients
headings.reviewNote: Holds insiders knowingly participating in preferences personally liable (with a four-month rebuttable presumption) and requires preference recipients to account to the liquidator.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires creditors to surrender voidable preferences or transfers before allowance of claims in liquidation.

headings.title: Surrender of voidable preferences prior to allowance
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits allowance of claim belonging to creditor who received voidable preference until transfer is surrendered.

headings.title: Excused late filing within thirty days of avoidance
headings.reviewNote: Permits a claim allowable after voluntary or involuntary preference avoidance to be filed as an excused late filing under section 375.1206 within 30 days of avoidance or court-allowed extended time.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates allowance of mutual debits and credits, setoff restrictions, and exceptions for unearned premiums and assessments.

headings.title: Allowance of mutual debts and credits as setoff
headings.reviewNote: Permits setoff of mutual debts and credits between insurer and creditor with balance allowed or paid.

headings.title: Exceptions and prohibitions against statutory setoff
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits setoff for non-claimant obligations, claims acquired for setoff, member assessments or capital contributions, affiliate obligations, and circular assumed-and-ceded reinsurance.

headings.title: Effective contract applicability dates for setoffs
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 375.1198 to obligations under contracts entered, renewed, or extended on or after July 1, 1992 and existing contracts terminating more than one year after January 1, 1993. Source note: former subsections 3-5 deleted and subsection 6 renumbered in 2004.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs liquidator financial reporting to court, assessment calculations against assessable members, and enforcement notices.

headings.title: Liquidator report on assets liabilities and assessment
headings.reviewNote: Requires liquidator to report insurer assets, liabilities, and estimated assessment needs for assessable mutuals.

headings.title: Court order of assessment against insurer members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to levy assessment against assessable members and policyholders to pay claims and expenses.

headings.title: Order to show cause for unpaid member assessments
headings.reviewNote: Directs the liquidator after an assessment levy to issue an order to show cause to each nonpaying member why judgment should not be pursued.

headings.title: Twenty-day mail and publication notice of show-cause order
headings.reviewNote: Requires giving notice of the show-cause order by publication and first-class mail at least 20 days before the return day.

headings.title: Default judgment or director hearing on objections
headings.reviewNote: Directs court judgment against non-appearing members, provides a director or referee hearing on timely verified objections, and allows 30-day court review.

headings.title: Enforcement and collection of assessment judgments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the liquidator to enforce any order or collect any judgment entered under subsection 5 by any lawful means.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates full reinsurance recoveries without reduction due to insurer delinquency and regulates direct payment exceptions.

headings.title: Reinsurance payable in full without delinquency reduction
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits reducing reinsurance recoverables due to delinquency proceedings and bars diminution for direct payments except when the reinsurance contract specifies direct payment on insolvency or the assuming insurer directly assumes obligations with insured consent.

headings.title: Reinsurer liability after life and health guaranty election
headings.reviewNote: Continues reinsurer liability for covered claims when a life and health guaranty association elects to succeed to reinsurance contracts, with payment at the association's direction discharging further liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires agents to remit collected unearned premiums to liquidator, prohibiting deductions and imposing penalties.

headings.title: Duty to remit unpaid earned premiums and unearned commissions
headings.reviewNote: Requires producers, premium finance companies, and insureds to pay unpaid earned premiums at insolvency, allows liquidator recovery of unearned-premium commissions, and bars setoffs for producer-advanced amounts.

headings.title: Administrative orders, level one penalties, and license sanctions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes section 374.046 administrative orders, classifies violations as level one under section 374.049, and permits suspending, revoking, or refusing licenses for willful violations.

headings.title: Civil actions for unpaid premium violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to maintain civil actions under section 374.048 for violations of this section, classified as level one violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs early access disbursement applications to guaranty associations, asset reserves, indemnity agreements, and court notices.

headings.title: Application for early access asset distribution
headings.reviewNote: Requires the liquidator within one year of a final liquidation order to apply to the court for approval of a proposal for early access disbursements to obligated guaranty associations.

headings.title: Required provisions of early access distribution plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires the early access proposal to reserve for administrative expenses, secured creditors, and class I claims, disburse initially within 120 days and annually thereafter, obtain return agreements (without bond or indemnity), require full accounting reports, and apply for court approval if assets are insufficient.

headings.title: Prohibition on charging interest to guaranty associations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits charging guaranty associations interest on disbursed assets, subject only to subsection 2(4) reporting of earned interest.

headings.title: Calculation of early access disbursement amounts
headings.reviewNote: Specifies disbursement calculations based on claims paid and reserves incurred by each guaranty association.

headings.title: Disbursements for life, health, and annuity insolvencies
headings.reviewNote: Requires proposals for insolvent life, health, or annuity insurers to provide disbursements to life and health guaranty associations or entities reinsuring, assuming, or guaranteeing policies.

headings.title: Thirty-day certified mail notice to associations and commissioners
headings.reviewNote: Requires certified first-class mail notice of each application to involved guaranty associations and state insurance commissioners at least 30 days before court submission.

headings.title: Prohibition on offsetting unforwarded statutory deposits
headings.reviewNote: Bars the liquidator from offsetting guaranty association disbursements by special or statutory deposits held in any state unless forwarded to the guaranty association.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes proof of claim filing deadlines, unexcused late filing rules, and share in subsequent distributions.

headings.title: Filing deadline for proofs of claim
headings.reviewNote: Requires proof of claim to be filed with liquidator on or before date specified in liquidation order.

headings.title: Treatment of late-filed claims in distribution
headings.reviewNote: Permits late-filed claims to share in subsequent distributions if delay was not due to claimant lack of diligence.

headings.title: Discretionary distributions for unexcused late claims
headings.reviewNote: Allows the liquidator in absolute discretion to permit unexcused late claims to share in subsequent distributions for same or lower priority claims at the lower-priority percentage if non-prejudicial.

entries.reviewSummary: Specifies mandatory form and contents of proof of claim, documentary verification, and supplemental information requests.

headings.title: Required contents and verification of claim form
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates required claim information including claim particulars, consideration, security, and verification under oath.

headings.title: Incomplete claims, prescribed forms, and court procedures
headings.reviewNote: Provides that incomplete claims need not be considered, allows the liquidator to require prescribed forms and documents, and permits the court to establish additional claims procedures.

headings.title: Liquidator authority to request supplemental information
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes liquidator to require claimant to furnish additional documentation or submit to examination under oath.

headings.title: Nonbinding effect of post-petition, default, or recent judgments
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that judgments or orders entered after liquidation petition filing, within four months prior, or at any time by default or collusion need not be considered evidence of liability or damages.

headings.title: Form and substantiation of guaranty association claims
headings.reviewNote: Provides that guaranty association and foreign guaranty association claims shall be in the form and contain the substantiation agreed to by the association and liquidator.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates allowance and estimation of contingent and unliquidated claims, discounting rules, and officer employment contracts.

headings.title: Third-party claims contingent on judgment against insured
headings.reviewNote: Requires considering and allowing a third party's claim contingent only on first obtaining a judgment against the insured as if no contingency existed.

headings.title: Participation of contingent claims in distribution
headings.reviewNote: Permits allowed contingent claims to share in declared asset distributions without delaying administration.

headings.title: Discounting of claims not yet due
headings.reviewNote: Treats unmatured claims as absolute claims discounted at statutory legal judgment interest rate.

headings.title: Limitation on claims under officer employment contracts
headings.reviewNote: Limits claims under officer and director employment contracts to services rendered prior to delinquency order.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs third-party claims against insureds in liquidation, insured protective claims, arbitration panels, and policy limit caps.

headings.title: Third-party claim against insured in liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes third party holding cause of action against insured of liquidated insurer to file claim with liquidator.

headings.title: Insured right to file protective claim
headings.reviewNote: Allows insured to file protective claim in liquidation whether or not third party files claim.

headings.title: Recommendation and dividend withholding on insured claims
headings.reviewNote: Directs liquidator recommendations and dividend withholding pending outcome of third-party litigation against insured.

headings.title: Arbitration panel for incurred but unreported liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Provides for valuation of unreported incurred liabilities by three-member arbitration panel under chapter 435.

headings.title: Proportional reduction for claims exceeding policy limits
headings.reviewNote: Reduces multiple claims under single policy ratably if aggregate allowed claims exceed applicable policy limit.

headings.title: Exclusion of claims covered by guaranty associations
headings.reviewNote: Bars presentation of third-party claims under this section if covered by insurance guaranty associations.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes sixty-day objection window upon claim denial, referee hearings, and court reconsideration procedures.

headings.title: Notice of claim denial and objection timeline
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice of claim denial and gives claimant sixty days to file written objections with liquidator.

headings.title: Hearing on objections before court or referee
headings.reviewNote: Provides for hearing on disputed claims before court or court-appointed referee and motion for reconsideration.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates valuation of collateral security held by secured creditors, deficiency claims, and surrender of security.

headings.title: Methods for determining value of creditor security
headings.reviewNote: Specifies security valuation by conversion to money under agreement terms or through arbitration and compromise.

headings.title: Treatment of deficiency and surrender of security
headings.reviewNote: Treats security deficiency as unsecured claim and allows full unsecured claim if creditor surrenders security.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs liquidator claim investigations, court supervision, estimation of group claims, policy deductibles, and commutations.

headings.title: Liquidator duty to investigate and negotiate claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires liquidator to review claims, negotiate allowances under court supervision, and enforce policy limits.

headings.title: Actuarial estimation of claims to prevent delay
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes estimation and allowance of claims through actuarial or statistical methods to prevent administrative delay.

headings.title: Limits on compelling reinsurer payment from estimates
headings.reviewNote: Allows using estimated contingent liabilities for fixing claims and dividends, bars compelling reinsurer payments from estimated IBNR or outstanding reserves (except section 375.1212), and addresses section 490.065 expert testimony.

headings.title: Commutation and release of reinsurance obligations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes liquidator to negotiate commutations and releases of reinsurance contracts with court approval.

headings.title: Exemption for pre-August 28, 1999 court orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides that subsection 3 does not apply to formal delinquency proceedings in which a court issued an order construing or applying this section before August 28, 1999.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires depositing unclaimed liquidation funds and undistributed withheld funds with the director of economic development under unclaimed property laws and applies retroactively.

headings.title: Deposit of unclaimed funds with economic development director
headings.reviewNote: Directs depositing unclaimed distribution funds remaining at liquidator discharge with the director of the department of economic development under unclaimed property laws.

headings.title: Disposition of undistributed section 375.1212 withheld funds
headings.reviewNote: Requires depositing undistributed withheld funds with the director of economic development for section 375.1218 distribution, with reverting sums converted to cash and deposited to general revenue.

headings.title: Applicability to pre- and post-1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 375.1224 to proceedings instituted both before and after August 28, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes court-directed retention or destruction of insurer records after liquidator discharge with a five-year retention floor and applies retroactively.

headings.title: Destruction of insurer records following discharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes liquidator to recommend and court to order destruction of obsolete insurer records upon discharge.

headings.title: Applicability to pre- and post-1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 375.1228 to delinquency proceedings commenced both before and after August 28, 1991, notwithstanding section 375.1158.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs director petitions to act as conservator of property of foreign or alien insurers and conservatorship termination.

headings.title: Grounds for conservatorship of foreign insurer property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to petition for conservatorship of property of foreign or alien insurer located in Missouri.

headings.title: Notice and response time for foreign insurer
headings.reviewNote: Requires the court to give the insurer reasonable notice and time to respond when a conservatorship order is sought.

headings.title: Conservatorship order terms and constructive notice recording
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to issue the order on appropriate terms and gives filing or recording with the clerk or county recorder of deeds the same notice as a recorded deed.

headings.title: Conservator petitions for liquidation or ancillary receivership
headings.reviewNote: Permits the conservator at any time to petition for a section 375.1234 asset liquidation order or a section 375.1236 ancillary receiver appointment.

headings.title: Application for termination of foreign conservatorship
headings.reviewNote: Allows conservator or foreign insurer to petition court to terminate conservatorship upon recovery or liquidation.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes director petition to liquidate Missouri assets of foreign or alien insurers, detailing grounds, title, and effect.

headings.title: Grounds for liquidating assets of foreign insurer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to petition for liquidation of Missouri assets of foreign insurer upon delinquency or insolvency.

headings.title: Notice and response time for foreign insurer
headings.reviewNote: Requires the court to give the insurer reasonable notice and time to respond when an asset liquidation order is sought.

headings.title: Liquidation order issuance and constructive notice recording
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to issue an order to liquidate when best interests require and gives filing or recording with the clerk or recorder of deeds constructive notice.

headings.title: Conversion to ancillary receiver on domiciliary liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the liquidator to act as ancillary receiver under section 375.1236 if a domiciliary liquidator is appointed in a reciprocal state, or petition to do so for a nonreciprocal state.

headings.title: Director petition for federal district court receivership
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director on subsection 1 grounds to petition an appropriate federal district court for appointment as receiver over insurer assets and business within federal jurisdiction.

headings.title: Payment of Missouri resident claims from liquidated assets
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to order the director to pay Missouri resident claims from liquidated foreign or alien insurer assets under compatible liquidation rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs title and powers of domiciliary liquidators from reciprocal states and claim filing venues for nonreciprocal states.

headings.title: Title and powers of reciprocal state liquidator
headings.reviewNote: Vests domiciliary liquidator of reciprocal state with title to all insurer assets and contracts located in Missouri.

headings.title: Duties of director regarding nonreciprocal state insurers
headings.reviewNote: Directs Missouri director to conserve Missouri assets of insurers domiciled in nonreciprocal states.

headings.title: Filing of claims by reciprocal and nonreciprocal residents
headings.reviewNote: Governs claim filing options with domiciliary or ancillary receivers based on claimant state reciprocity.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates appointment of director as ancillary receiver for foreign insurers, title to local assets, and transfer to domicile.

headings.title: Grounds for appointing director as ancillary receiver
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to petition Cole County circuit court for appointment as ancillary receiver if sufficient Missouri assets exist or protection of Missouri creditors or policyholders requires it.

headings.title: Ancillary appointment order and constructive notice recording
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to issue an ancillary receiver appointment order on appropriate terms, with recording in the recorder of deeds imparting constructive notice.

headings.title: Powers and duties of ancillary receiver in Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ancillary receiver to liquidate special deposits, determine claims, and transfer surplus to domiciliary liquidator.

headings.title: Reciprocal-state ancillary receiver rights and powers
headings.reviewNote: Grants ancillary receivers appointed in reciprocal states corresponding rights, duties, and powers when a domiciliary liquidator is appointed in Missouri.

headings.title: Limits on ancillary administrative costs and asset offsets
headings.reviewNote: Bars an ancillary receivership from recovering administrative costs unless requested in writing by the domiciliary liquidator or official, and offsets unrequested recoveries at maximum potential value.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates claim filing venues for nonresident claimants in Missouri domestic insurer liquidations and proof conclusive effect.

headings.title: Filing options for nonresident claimants in Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Requires nonreciprocal claimants to file in Missouri while allowing reciprocal claimants to file with ancillary receivers.

headings.title: Conclusive effect of ancillary claim allowances
headings.reviewNote: Deems final ancillary claim allowance conclusive as to amount and special deposit priority but not general assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs claim filing and proof procedures for Missouri residents against foreign insurers in reciprocal state liquidations.

headings.title: Claim filing by Missouri residents against foreign insurers
headings.reviewNote: Allows Missouri residents to file claims either with Missouri ancillary receiver or with domiciliary liquidator.

headings.title: Proving claims in Missouri ancillary proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes procedure for proving claims before Missouri ancillary receiver and forty-day notice to foreign liquidator.

headings.title: Conclusive effect of Missouri ancillary claim judgment
headings.reviewNote: Makes Missouri court allowance of claim conclusive as to amount and priority against Missouri special deposits.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes equal distribution priority across reciprocal states, special deposit preferences, and secured creditor rights.

headings.title: Equal priority of payment across reciprocal states
headings.reviewNote: Gives residents of reciprocal states equal priority of payment from general assets under domiciliary distribution rules.

headings.title: Priority of claims against special statutory deposits
headings.reviewNote: Grants special deposit claimants priority against deposits, deferring general asset sharing until parity is achieved.

headings.title: Surrender or liquidation of secured creditor collateral
headings.reviewNote: Allows secured creditors to surrender security for general claim or exhaust collateral and treat deficiency as general claim.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires annual risk-based capital reporting by March first, formula risk factors, capital maintenance goals, and director adjustments.

headings.title: Annual risk-based capital report filing deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires domestic insurers and health organizations to submit annual RBC report to director and NAIC by March first.

headings.title: RBC calculation formula for life insurers
headings.reviewNote: Specifies life and health insurer risk formula accounting for asset risk, adverse experience, and interest rates.

headings.title: RBC calculation for property casualty insurers
headings.reviewNote: Specifies property and casualty risk formula factoring asset risk, credit risk, and underwriting risk covariance.

headings.title: RBC calculation formula for health organizations
headings.reviewNote: Specifies health organization risk formula evaluating asset, credit, and underwriting risks under instructions.

headings.title: Insurer duty to maintain capital above minimums
headings.reviewNote: Encourages insurers and health organizations to maintain surplus capital above mandatory statutory minimums.

headings.title: Director authority to adjust inaccurate reports
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to adjust inaccurate reports and provide written statement of reasons to insurer.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines company action level events, mandatory RBC plan submission, approval procedures, and multi-state filing duties.

headings.title: Events triggering company action level status
headings.reviewNote: Defines triggering events including capital falling below company action level or negative trend results.

headings.title: Required contents and projections of RBC plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires an RBC plan to identify contributing conditions, propose corrective actions, provide 4-year insurer or 2-year health-organization projections, identify key assumptions, and detail business quality and problems.

headings.title: Forty-five-day submission deadline for RBC plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires submitting the RBC plan within 45 days of the company action level event or within 45 days after post-hearing rejection of a challenge to an adjusted RBC report.

headings.title: Director sixty-day review and forty-five-day revised plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director within 60 days to approve or reject the RBC plan with reasons and optional revisions, and requires a revised plan within 45 days of notice or post-hearing rejection.

headings.title: Discretionary regulatory action level designation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director, subject to a section 375.1265 hearing, to specify that an unsatisfactory RBC plan or revised plan notification constitutes a regulatory action level event.

headings.title: Filing RBC plan with other state commissioners
headings.reviewNote: Requires domestic insurer to file copy of approved plan with commissioners of all licensed states upon request.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines regulatory action level events, director corrective examination powers, mandatory remedial orders, and consultant retainers.

headings.title: Events triggering regulatory action level status
headings.reviewNote: Defines triggering events including capital below regulatory action level or failure to adhere to plan.

headings.title: Director examination and mandatory corrective orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to examine insurer operations, require plan submission, and issue corrective orders.

headings.title: Corrective action factors and forty-five-day plan deadline
headings.reviewNote: Allows considering relevant factors including sensitivity tests in setting corrective actions and requires submitting the RBC plan or revised plan within 45 days of the event or post-hearing challenge rejection.

headings.title: Retention of actuaries and consultants at insurer expense
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to retain actuaries, investment experts, and other consultants to review plans, analyze operations, and formulate corrective orders at the affected insurer's or health organization's expense.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines authorized control level events and empowers director to initiate rehabilitation or regulatory control actions.

headings.title: Events triggering authorized control level status
headings.reviewNote: Defines triggering events including capital below authorized control level or uncorrected regulatory events.

headings.title: Director authority to initiate rehabilitation actions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to take regulatory action or place insurer under supervision, rehabilitation, or liquidation.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines mandatory control level events and requires director to place insurer into rehabilitation or liquidation.

headings.title: Events triggering mandatory control level status
headings.reviewNote: Defines mandatory control level event as capital falling below mandatory control level threshold.

headings.title: Mandatory duty to initiate receivership proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Mandates director to initiate rehabilitation or liquidation proceedings against insurer in mandatory control level.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides administrative hearing rights regarding adjusted RBC reports and corrective orders, specifying review procedures.

headings.title: Right to departmental hearing on RBC determinations
headings.reviewNote: Grants insurer right to request administrative hearing upon adjusted report, plan rejection, or corrective order.

headings.title: Conditional judicial review and action consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Allows judicial review under sections 536.100 to 536.140 only if the director makes the order public, takes RBC or delinquency action, or issues a post-hearing corrective order, consolidating review with director actions.

headings.title: Exclusivity of subsection 2 judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits judicial review of any director action under sections 375.1250 to 375.1275 except as provided in subsection 2.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory confidentiality of RBC reports, bars commercial advertising use, and restricts ratemaking reliance.

headings.title: Confidentiality of RBC reports and plans
headings.reviewNote: Affords confidential status to RBC reports, plans, and results, exempting them from subpoena or public records.

headings.title: Prohibition against commercial advertising use of RBC
headings.reviewNote: Deems advertising or publishing RBC levels an unfair trade practice under section 375.934, with an exception allowing written rebuttal announcements against materially false published comparisons.

headings.title: Prohibition on using RBC data for ratemaking
headings.reviewNote: Restricts RBC instructions, reports, and plans solely to solvency monitoring and bars using or introducing them in ratemaking, rate proceedings, or calculating premium levels or rates of return.

headings.title: Confidential information sharing with regulators and NAIC
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to share confidential RBC materials with other regulators, the NAIC, and law enforcement under confidentiality agreements, receive confidential materials, and enter sharing agreements.

headings.title: Preservation of privilege and confidentiality on disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Provides that disclosure to the director or authorized sharing under subsection 4(3) does not waive any applicable privilege or claim of confidentiality.

entries.reviewSummary: Declares supplemental nature of RBC laws, authorizes chapter 536 rules, permits exemptions for small domestic property-casualty insurers and health organizations, and grants official immunity.

headings.title: Supplemental construction with other insurance laws
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that risk-based capital provisions supplement rather than supplant other insurance regulatory laws.

headings.title: Promulgation of risk-based capital rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to adopt administrative rules and instructions to implement risk-based capital requirements.

headings.title: Discretionary exemption for small domestic property-casualty insurers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to exempt domestic property and casualty insurers writing direct business only in Missouri with $2 million or less in direct annual premiums and no more than 5% assumed reinsurance.

headings.title: Discretionary exemption for small domestic health organizations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to exempt domestic health organizations meeting Missouri-only, $2 million premium, and 5% reinsurance limits, or limited health service organizations covering fewer than 2,000 lives.

headings.title: Immunity of director and department personnel
headings.reviewNote: Grants civil immunity to director, department employees, and contractors for acts performed under RBC laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates foreign insurer RBC report submissions, mandatory plan filings, and director receivership authority.

headings.title: Submission of RBC reports by foreign insurers
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign insurer to submit RBC report upon written request of director within fifteen days.

headings.title: Filing of RBC plans by foreign insurers
headings.reviewNote: Directs foreign insurer experiencing company action level event to file remedial plan upon director request.

headings.title: Remedial actions upon foreign insurer noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to order foreign insurer to submit plan if its domiciliary state fails to require compliance.

headings.title: Authority to petition for foreign insurer liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to initiate conservatorship or liquidation proceedings against foreign insurer in mandatory control.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes transitional phase-in rules for initial RBC filings by life, property casualty, and health organizations.

headings.title: Phase-in requirements for calendar year 1993
headings.reviewNote: Establishes phase-in standards for life and health insurer reports filed for calendar year 1993.

headings.title: Phase-in requirements for calendar year 1996
headings.reviewNote: Sets transition rules for property and casualty insurer reports filed for calendar year 1996.

headings.title: Phase-in requirements for health organizations
headings.reviewNote: Provides transitional standards for health organization reports filed for calendar year 2014.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines statutory scope of assumption reinsurance act and enumerates excluded reinsurance transactions.

headings.title: Applicability to assumption reinsurance transfers
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 375.1280 to 375.1295 to insurers transferring policies under assumption reinsurance agreements.

headings.title: Exemptions from assumption reinsurance provisions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts indemnity reinsurance, corporate mergers, plan transfers, and transfers directed by receivership courts.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs notice of transfer disclosures to policyholders, prior director approval criteria, and felony noncompliance penalties.

headings.title: Mandatory notice of transfer to policyholders
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes exact form and response card for notice of transfer informing policyholders of novation rights.

headings.title: Prior director approval for assumption reinsurance
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days prior approval by director based on financial solvency, fairness, and competition factors.

headings.title: Class E felony for unauthorized policy transfers
headings.reviewNote: Classifies willful violation of assumption reinsurance transfer approval provisions as a class E felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs policyholder right to reject transfer, premium payment deeming, second and third notices, and receipt timing.

headings.title: Policyholder right to reject assumption transfer
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees policyholders the right to reject transfer and retain coverage with the transferring insurer.

headings.title: Deemed acceptance upon payment of premium
headings.reviewNote: Deems premium payment to assuming insurer as acceptance of transfer if notice clearly so states.

headings.title: Second and third notice requirements and deemed consent
headings.reviewNote: Requires follow-up notices at twelve and twenty-four months, deeming consent after final notice if unrejected.

headings.title: Determination of response card receipt date
headings.reviewNote: Deems rejection response received on postmark date or date of actual receipt for courier or electronic transmission.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes effective date for assumption reinsurance provisions and preserves prior criminal penalty liabilities.

headings.title: Application to post-enactment assumption agreements
headings.reviewNote: Applies assumption reinsurance provisions to all agreements entered into on or after August 28, 1993.

headings.title: Saving clause for pre-enactment violations
headings.reviewNote: Preserves prosecution and penalties for acts committed prior to August 28, 1993, under section 375.241.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits insurer genetic testing mandates, discrimination based on test results, and defines health plan exclusions.

headings.title: Prohibited genetic testing and underwriting inquiries
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits insurers from requiring genetic tests or using genetic information in health plan underwriting.

headings.title: Unfair trade practice penalties for violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violation of genetic testing restrictions as unfair trade practices under sections 375.930 to 375.948.

headings.title: Definition and scope of health plan
headings.reviewNote: Excludes life insurance, reinsurance, disability income, and long-term care coverage from the definition of health plan and applies to applications, issuances, and renewals on or after January 1, 1999.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits employer discrimination using genetic information subject to enumerated exceptions and authorizes director administrative orders and civil actions for level two violations.

headings.title: Prohibition on employer use of genetic information
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits employers from refusing to hire, discharging, or discriminating regarding compensation using genetic data.

headings.title: Director administrative orders and level two penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to issue administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies violations of this section as level two violations under section 374.049.

headings.title: Director civil actions for employer genetic violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to maintain civil actions for relief under section 374.048 and classifies violations as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires confidentiality of genetic information subject to research, legal process, and identification exceptions, and authorizes director administrative orders and civil actions.

headings.title: Confidentiality of genetic testing records
headings.reviewNote: Requires holding genetic information as confidential medical records absent written authorization, with exceptions for de-identified statistical data, federal-common-rule or coded health research, legal or regulatory process, and body identification.

headings.title: Director administrative orders and level two penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to issue administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies violations of this section as level two violations under section 374.049.

headings.title: Director civil actions for unauthorized genetic disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to maintain civil actions for relief under section 374.048 and classifies violations as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits insurance discrimination against domestic violence victims, protects innocent coinsured property rights, and defines penalties.

headings.title: Definitions for domestic violence insurance protections
headings.reviewNote: Defines domestic violence, family or household member (per section 455.010), innocent coinsured, and sole for purposes of this section.

headings.title: Prohibited insurer actions based on victim status
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits insurers from taking six specified adverse coverage, pricing, claim, preexisting-condition, group-termination, or agent-commission actions solely based on domestic violence victim status.

headings.title: Prohibition on victim status as underwriting criterion
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits considering an insured's or prospective insured's status as a domestic violence victim as a permitted underwriting or rating criterion.

headings.title: Permissibility of uniform non-discriminatory actions
headings.reviewNote: Permits insurers to take otherwise lawful subsection 2 actions applied uniformly to all insureds without regard to domestic violence victim status.

headings.title: Innocent coinsured property claim payment and subrogation
headings.reviewNote: Bars denying an innocent coinsured's property claim under an intentional-act exclusion upon police report and sworn cooperation affidavit, limits payment to ownership interest less secured claims, and grants subrogation against the perpetrator.

headings.title: Unfair trade practice penalties for violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violation of domestic violence protections as an unfair trade practice under sections 375.930 to 375.948.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets short title of Insurance Data Security Act, establishes exclusive state standards, and disclaims private right of action.

headings.title: Citation of insurance data security act
headings.reviewNote: Cites sections 375.1400 to 375.1427 as the Insurance Data Security Act.

headings.title: Exclusive state data security standards for licensees
headings.reviewNote: Establishes exclusive state standards for insurance licensee data security and cybersecurity event investigation.

headings.title: Disclaimer of private cause of action
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the act does not create or imply any private cause of action or expand licensee civil liabilities.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates comprehensive information security programs, risk assessments, board oversight, incident plans, and annual certifications.

headings.title: Comprehensive written information security program requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to maintain comprehensive written security program protecting nonpublic data and systems.

headings.title: Security program objectives and protection standards
headings.reviewNote: Specifies program objectives to safeguard consumer data, mitigate threats, and define record disposal schedules.

headings.title: Mandatory risk assessment and threat identification
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensee to conduct periodic risk assessments evaluating reasonably foreseeable security vulnerabilities.

headings.title: Implementation of technical and organizational safeguards
headings.reviewNote: Mandates security safeguards including access controls, encryption, multi-factor authentication, and audit trails.

headings.title: Board of directors oversight of security program
headings.reviewNote: Requires board of directors to oversee security program and receive annual written reports on security status.

headings.title: Oversight of third-party service provider arrangements
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensee to exercise due diligence and require third-party service providers to implement security safeguards.

headings.title: Program adjustments based on operational changes
headings.reviewNote: Directs licensee to monitor and adjust security program in response to changes in technology and evolving threats.

headings.title: Establishment of written incident response plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensee to establish written incident response plan to promptly respond to and recover from cyber events.

headings.title: Annual written certification of compliance to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires domestic insurers to submit annual certification to director confirming compliance with security standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs prompt licensee investigation of cybersecurity events, required investigation steps, third-party service provider system breaches, and three-year record retention.

headings.title: Licensee duty to investigate cybersecurity events
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensee discovering cybersecurity event to conduct prompt investigation assessing scope and impact.

headings.title: Minimum required cybersecurity investigation determinations
headings.reviewNote: Requires the licensee or designated vendor to determine whether an event occurred, assess nature and scope, identify involved nonpublic information, and restore compromised system security.

headings.title: Investigation of third-party service provider system events
headings.reviewNote: Requires a licensee learning of a potential cybersecurity event in a third-party service provider's system to complete subsection 2 steps or confirm and document that the provider completed them.

headings.title: Three-year retention and production of event records
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to maintain records concerning all cybersecurity events for at least three years from the event date and produce them upon director demand.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates fourteen grounds for producer license discipline, chapter 621 appeal rights, business entity accountability, post-lapse jurisdiction, and thirty-day reporting of address changes, administrative actions, and criminal prosecutions.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for producer license disciplinary action
headings.reviewNote: Lists fourteen statutory grounds including dishonesty, fraud, felony convictions, and financial misappropriation.

headings.title: Notice of refusal and right to hearing
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice with reasons for license denial or nonrenewal, with appeal governed by chapter 621.

headings.title: Discipline of business entity producer licenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes discipline of business entity license if partner or officer violation was known and uncorrected.

headings.title: Jurisdiction over lapsed or surrendered licenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to revoke or suspend a license under subsection 1 even where the licensee failed to renew or surrendered the license.

headings.title: Thirty-day address change notice and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires producers to report address changes within 30 days and allows immediate revocation until service is obtained if failure prevents serving a chapter 621 complaint.

headings.title: Thirty-day reporting of administrative actions
headings.reviewNote: Requires producers to report administrative actions taken in another jurisdiction or by another Missouri governmental agency within 30 days of final disposition, including legal documents.

headings.title: Thirty-day reporting of felony or moral turpitude prosecutions
headings.reviewNote: Requires producers to report any felony or moral turpitude criminal prosecution in any jurisdiction within 30 days of the initial pretrial hearing date, including charging and hearing documents.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires cybersecurity event notification to the director within four business days, specifies required contents and consumer breach notices, and allocates third-party, reinsurer, and producer duties.

headings.title: Four-business-day notice of cybersecurity event to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to notify the director as promptly as practicable and within four business days of determining a reportable cybersecurity event involving nonpublic information has occurred.

headings.title: Required contents and ongoing updates of notice
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates mandatory notice details including event date, affected consumers, remediation, and ongoing updates.

headings.title: Submission of consumer breach notice to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensee to provide director copy of consumer notices sent pursuant to state breach notification statute.

headings.title: Cybersecurity events in third-party provider systems
headings.reviewNote: Governs notice obligations when cybersecurity event occurs within systems of third-party service providers.

headings.title: Notice obligations of assuming and ceding insurers
headings.reviewNote: Allocates breach notification duties between assuming reinsurers and ceding insurers having consumer relationships.

headings.title: Insurer notice to independent producers of record
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer to notify independent producers of record whose consumers are affected by cybersecurity event.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes director examination and investigation powers to enforce compliance with data security laws.

headings.title: Director power to examine and investigate licensees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to examine and investigate affairs of licensees under sections 374.190 and 374.205.

headings.title: Director enforcement authority for data security violations
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to take necessary administrative and legal action to enforce insurance data security provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Affords confidentiality to data security filings, restricts public disclosure and commercial use, and permits regulatory sharing.

headings.title: Confidential and privileged status of security filings
headings.reviewNote: Protects cybersecurity filings and exam materials from sunshine law disclosure, subpoena, and discovery.

headings.title: Testimonial privilege in private civil litigation
headings.reviewNote: Shields director and department personnel from testifying in private civil actions concerning confidential data.

headings.title: Sharing restrictions and commercial use prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes sharing with regulatory agencies while barring release for commercial use or sale of cyber data.

headings.title: Receipt of confidential materials from other regulators
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to receive and maintain confidential information from NAIC and law enforcement officials.

headings.title: Preservation of privilege upon information sharing
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that sharing documents does not constitute waiver of confidentiality or evidentiary privileges.

headings.title: Public release of final adjudicated disciplinary actions
headings.reviewNote: Permits director to release final adjudicated regulatory actions to NAIC databases and clearinghouses.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory exemptions from data security requirements for small businesses, HIPAA entities, and affiliates.

headings.title: Exemptions for small employers and HIPAA entities
headings.reviewNote: Establishes five exceptions covering licensees with under 10 employees, HIPAA/HITECH-compliant entities (except section 375.1410(1)-(2) notice), covered employees/agents, small producers (<50 employees, <$5M revenue, or <$10M assets), and GLBA-compliant depository institution affiliates.

headings.title: 180-day compliance period after losing exemption
headings.reviewNote: Gives a licensee 180 calendar days to comply with sections 375.1400 to 375.1427 after ceasing to qualify for an exception.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes director administrative orders and civil actions for producer licensing violations, classifying violations as level two or level four under section 374.049.

headings.title: Administrative orders and level two or four penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes section 374.046 administrative orders for violations of sections 375.012 to 375.144, classifying sections 375.012 to 375.142 as level two and section 375.144 as level four under section 374.049.

headings.title: Civil actions for producer licensing violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to maintain civil actions under section 374.048, classifying sections 375.012 to 375.142 as level two and section 375.144 as level four under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes criminal felony and misdemeanor penalties, mandatory court-ordered license revocation, prosecutorial referrals, and preservation of other criminal laws for producer violations.

headings.title: Criminal felony penalty for fraudulent section 375.144 violations
headings.reviewNote: Imposes up to a $100,000 fine and/or 10 years imprisonment, optional double-loss restitution, and mandatory court-ordered license revocation for knowing fraudulent violations of section 375.144.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor and license revocation for willful violations
