headings.reviewNote: Makes willful violation of sections 375.012 to 375.141 a class A misdemeanor with mandatory court-ordered revocation of any license held under those sections.

headings.title: Director referral of evidence to prosecuting attorneys
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to refer available evidence of chapter violations to the proper prosecuting or circuit attorney for criminal proceedings.

headings.title: Preservation of criminal punishment under other statutes
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not limit state power to punish conduct constituting a crime under any other state statute.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets short title of Managing General Agents Act, defines key statutory terms, and establishes effective date.

headings.title: Citation of managing general agents act
headings.reviewNote: Cites sections 375.147 to 375.153 as the Managing General Agents Act.

headings.title: July 1, 1991 effective date and compliance mandate
headings.reviewNote: Sets July 1, 1991 as the effective date for sections 375.147 to 375.153 and prohibits insurers from using noncompliant managing general agents after June 30, 1991.

headings.title: Definitions for Managing General Agents Act
headings.reviewNote: Defines actuary, director, insurer, managing general agent (with five statutory exclusions), and underwrite for sections 375.147 to 375.153.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates producer licensure for managing general agents, regulating domestic and foreign entities, surety bonds, and liability coverage.

headings.title: License requirement for managing general agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires managing general agents acting for Missouri insurers or on Missouri risks to hold producer license.

headings.title: Licensing for out-of-state risks of domestic insurers
headings.reviewNote: Requires any managing general agent representing a Missouri-domiciled insurer for risks located outside Missouri to hold a Missouri producer license (which may be a nonresident license).

headings.title: Surety bond requirement for managing general agents
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to require managing general agents to maintain surety bond for protection of insurer.

headings.title: Errors and omissions insurance policy requirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to require managing general agents to maintain errors and omissions liability policy.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes insurer oversight duties regarding managing general agents, audits, loss reserves, board boundaries, and termination notice.

headings.title: Insurer duty to obtain audited financial reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer to have on file independent audited financial report of each managing general agent it retains.

headings.title: Actuarial opinion on loss reserves established
headings.reviewNote: Mandates insurer to obtain independent actuarial opinion on loss reserves established by managing general agent.

headings.title: Periodic on-site operational review of MGA
headings.reviewNote: Requires the insurer to periodically conduct an on-site review of the underwriting and claims processing operations of the managing general agent.

headings.title: Binding authority for reinsurance contracts
headings.reviewNote: Requires binding authority for reinsurance contracts to remain with nonaffiliated officer of the insurer.

headings.title: Notice of appointment or termination to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer to notify director within thirty days of appointment or contract termination of managing general agent.

headings.title: Quarterly review to identify new managing general agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers to quarterly review books and records to determine if any producer became a managing general agent, promptly notify the producer and director, and achieve full compliance within 30 days.

headings.title: Prohibition on MGA board appointments and chapter 382 exception
headings.reviewNote: Bars appointing any MGA officer, director, employee, or controlling shareholder to the insurer's board of directors, exempting chapter 382 holding-company relationships. Source note: word 'an' appears in original rolls.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates insurer election to market life policies without illustration, notice to director, and basic illustration mandates.

headings.title: Notice to director of non-illustrated policy forms
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer to notify director of policy forms being marketed without illustrations before marketing.

headings.title: Prohibition on illustration for non-illustrated policies
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits producers from using illustrations in marketing policies designated as non-illustrated forms.

headings.title: Basic illustration requirement for illustrated policy forms
headings.reviewNote: Requires a basic illustration for forms marketed with illustrations, exempting individual group or multiple-lives members unless marketed to them and allowing individual or composite illustrations.

headings.title: Nonterm group life quotations and enrollee illustrations
headings.reviewNote: Requires furnishing guaranteed and nonguaranteed sample quotations with nonterm group life enrollment materials and providing a basic illustration at delivery for above-minimum-premium enrollees or upon request.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes labeling standards, required contents, and prohibited practices in life insurance sales presentations.

headings.title: Labeling and presentation standards for illustrations
headings.reviewNote: Requires illustrations to be clearly labeled, complete, and not represented as anything other than illustration.

headings.title: Prohibited statements and misleading presentation practices
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits representing nonguaranteed elements as guaranteed or using vanishing premium or similar misleading terms.

headings.title: Interest rate limitations and dividend scale rules
headings.reviewNote: Restricts illustrated interest rates and nonguaranteed scales to current company experience without projection.

entries.reviewSummary: Specifies mandatory format, narrative summary, numeric summary, and tabular disclosures for basic life illustrations.

headings.title: General formatting and labeling rules for basic illustrations
headings.reviewNote: Sets fourteen formatting, labeling, guaranteed-before-nonguaranteed, surrender value, disclaimer, and paid-up disclosure requirements for basic illustrations.

headings.title: Narrative summary describing policy features and risks
headings.reviewNote: Mandates narrative summary describing contractual features, premium options, guaranteed vs nonguaranteed values.

headings.title: Numeric summary page and policy comparison periods
headings.reviewNote: Requires numeric summary displaying death benefit and cash value at years five, ten, twenty, and age seventy.

headings.title: Signed applicant and producer statements on numeric summary
headings.reviewNote: Requires prescribed signed and dated acknowledgment statements by the applicant or policy owner and the producer or insurer representative on the numeric summary page.

headings.title: Tabular detail durations and zero guaranteed value display
headings.reviewNote: Requires tabular premium outlay, guaranteed death benefit, and surrender values for years 1-10, every fifth year thereafter to age 100 or maturity, and premium-change years, displaying zero in the guaranteed column if no guaranteed value exists.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates supplemental life insurance illustrations, requiring basic illustration attachment and guaranteed notice disclosures.

headings.title: Conditions for providing supplemental life illustrations
headings.reviewNote: Permits supplemental illustrations if accompanied by basic illustration and matching premium outlay.

headings.title: Notice referring to basic illustration for guarantees
headings.reviewNote: Requires supplemental illustration to include prominent notice directing policyholder to basic illustration guarantees.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs illustration submission at sale, revised illustrations upon delivery, mailed sales, three-year retention, and summary exemption.

headings.title: Submission of basic and revised sales illustrations
headings.reviewNote: Requires signed basic illustration with application and revised illustration upon policy delivery if modified.

headings.title: Certification and acknowledgment when no illustration used
headings.reviewNote: Requires producer certification and applicant acknowledgment if no illustration was used at time of application.

headings.title: Procedures for illustrations delivered by mail
headings.reviewNote: Specifies return instructions and diligent effort standards for securing signed numeric summaries by mail.

headings.title: Three-year record retention following policy termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer to retain signed illustrations and certifications until three years after policy terminates.

headings.title: Exemption from separate policy summary requirements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts policies marketed with illustrations from separate policy summary requirement under section 376.706.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes administrative sanctions, civil actions, insurer reimbursement orders, and preserves third-party rights for MGA violations.

headings.title: Administrative orders and level two penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies MGA violations as level two.

headings.title: Civil actions and insurer reimbursement orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes civil actions and empowers director to order MGA to reimburse insurer or liquidator for incurred losses.

headings.title: Preservation of other statutory penalties
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that section penalties do not affect director authority to impose other penalties under insurance law.

headings.title: Preservation of policyholder and creditor rights
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that MGA provisions do not limit or restrict the legal rights of policyholders, claimants, or creditors.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates annual policy status reports to owners of illustrated life policies, required contents, and in-force illustration notices.

headings.title: Required contents of annual policy status report
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates report items including policy values, death benefit, premiums, debits, credits, loans, and lapse notices.

headings.title: Notice of right to request in-force illustration
headings.reviewNote: Requires prominent annual notice advising policy owner of right to request in-force illustration without charge.

headings.title: Furnishing compliant in-force illustration on request
headings.reviewNote: Requires the insurer, upon policy owner request, to furnish an in-force illustration complying with sections 375.1509(1)-(2) and 375.1512(1) and (5) without requiring signature or acknowledgment.

headings.title: Prominent notice of adverse nonguaranteed element changes
headings.reviewNote: Requires the annual report to prominently display notice of any adverse change in nonguaranteed elements affecting the policy made since the last annual report and the nature of the change.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates appointment of illustration actuary, annual certifications, testing standards, and notice of actuary change.

headings.title: Appointment of qualified illustration actuary
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer board to appoint qualified illustration actuary meeting Academy of Actuaries qualification standards.

headings.title: Actuarial certification of disciplined and illustrated scales
headings.reviewNote: Requires the illustration actuary to certify that the disciplined current scale conforms to Actuarial Standards Board standards and that illustrated scales meet sections 375.1500 to 375.1527.

headings.title: Illustration actuary qualifications and annual disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Requires AAA membership, standard-of-practice familiarity, clean regulatory history, interstate disciplinary notice, and annual disclosures of scale reductions, inconsistencies, and overhead expense allocation methods.

headings.title: Filing certifications annually, for new forms, and on errors
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing certifications with the board and director annually for illustrated forms and before illustrating a new form, plus prompt notice upon discovering an error in a prior certification.

headings.title: Notice of inability to certify illustrated scales
headings.reviewNote: Requires illustration actuary to immediately notify board and director if scales fail to meet testing rules.

headings.title: Annual corporate officer certification to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer officer to certify annually that illustrations comply with rules and producer training guidelines.

headings.title: Insurer-determined annual certification filing date
headings.reviewNote: Requires providing annual certifications to the director each year by a date determined by the insurer.

headings.title: Prompt notice to director of actuary change
headings.reviewNote: Requires an insurer changing the illustration actuary for any policy forms to promptly notify the director and disclose the reason for the change.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires insurer compliance with all state insurance laws prior to transacting business and regulates commission recipients.

headings.title: Compliance with insurance laws before transacting business
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits insurers from transacting business until fully complying with all Missouri insurance laws and rules.

headings.title: Authorized business and life insurer risk limitations
headings.reviewNote: Restricts domestic insurers to statutorily authorized risks and limits life insurers to human life, annuities, endowments, and accident and sickness insurance under sections 376.010 and 376.309.

headings.title: Commissions restricted to licensed producers and entities
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits insurers doing business in Missouri from paying producer commissions or compensation except to licensed insurance producers of the insurer and licensed business entity producers.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs limited lines travel insurance producer licensing, travel retailer authorization, brochures, premium tax, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Definitions for travel insurance producer regulation
headings.reviewNote: Defines director, limited lines travel producer, offer and disseminate, planned trip, travel insurance, and travel retailer.

headings.title: Statutory scope and superseding effect for travel insurance
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 375.159 to travel insurance covering Missouri residents or delivered in Missouri (excluding cancellation fee waivers and travel assistance services) and supersedes conflicting general insurance laws.

headings.title: Travel producer licensing and travel retailer requirements
headings.reviewNote: Governs limited lines travel producer licensing, travel retailer registration, disclosures, brochures, training, prohibited unlicensed acts, compensation, policy types, supervising responsibility, and major-line producer authority.

headings.title: Travel insurer premium tax and residency documentation
headings.reviewNote: Requires travel insurers to pay section 148.370 premium tax on Missouri resident policyholders, certificate holders, and blanket policies, document residency, and exclude travel assistance and cancellation fee waiver amounts.

headings.title: Bundled single-price travel protection plan disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Allows offering travel protection plans for one combined price if pre-purchase disclosures and fulfillment materials clearly delineate travel insurance, travel assistance services, and cancellation fee waivers.

headings.title: Unfair trade practices, free-look refunds, and opt-out ban
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 375.930 to 375.948, bars illusory policies, opt-out sales, and 'free' blanket marketing, mandates preexisting-condition and primary/secondary disclosures, and grants 15-day mail or 10-day electronic full-refund cancellation.

headings.title: Travel administrator licensing and insurer responsibility
headings.reviewNote: Requires travel administrators to hold a P&C producer, MGA, or third-party administrator license and holds insurers responsible for administrator acts and records.

headings.title: Inland marine or health rate filing and underwriting
headings.reviewNote: Classifies travel insurance under inland marine for rates and forms (permitting accident and health filing for travel sickness/accident/disability/death coverage) and sets underwriting standards.

headings.title: Applicability of chapters 374 and 375 to travel licensees
headings.reviewNote: Subjects limited lines travel insurance producers and registered travel retailers to chapters 374 and 375 except as provided in this section.

headings.title: Promulgation of travel insurance administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to promulgate rules to administer and enforce travel insurance provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs handling of large deductible claims by guaranty associations, deductible reimbursement collections, and collateral allocations.

headings.title: Applicability to workers' compensation large deductible policies
headings.reviewNote: Applies to workers' compensation large deductible policies of insurers in delinquency proceedings, excluding first-party claims and claims funded net of deductible unless subsection 3 applies.

headings.title: Definitions for large deductible claim handling
headings.reviewNote: Defines collateral, covered claim, deductible amount, large deductible policy, and reimbursement.

headings.title: Guaranty association handling of large deductible claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires guaranty association to process and pay covered claims subject to large deductibles up to statutory limits.

headings.title: Guaranty association right to reimbursements and collateral
headings.reviewNote: Entitles a guaranty association paying deductible claims to full insured reimbursements and available collateral (less subsection 7 receiver expenses), outside sections 375.1218 and 375.1205, with a delinquency claim for unreimbursed amounts.

headings.title: Receiver billing, collection duty, and barred defenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires the receiver to promptly bill and take commercially reasonable actions to collect deductible reimbursements (after policy period or 60 days), barring insurer insolvency or claim-handling (except gross negligence) as defenses.

headings.title: Collateral drawdown, order of claims, and proration
headings.reviewNote: Directs the receiver to utilize and draw down collateral upon insured nonpayment, pay valid claims in order received (or prorate if insufficient across creditors), and periodically return excess collateral.

headings.title: Receiver deduction of collection expenses with court approval
headings.reviewNote: Entitles the receiver to deduct reasonable and actual collection expenses from collateral or deductible reimbursements, subject to court review and approval.

headings.title: Supervising court jurisdiction over large deductible disputes
headings.reviewNote: Grants the court with jurisdiction over delinquency proceedings under section 375.1154 jurisdiction to resolve disputes arising under this section.

headings.title: Effective applicability to proceedings on or after September 14, 2016
headings.reviewNote: Applies to delinquency proceedings commenced or open and pending on or after September 14, 2016, excluding those with a prior final liquidation order finding insolvency. Source note: veto overridden September 14, 2016.

headings.title: Preservation of guaranty association policyholder recovery rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not limit or adversely affect guaranty association rights under applicable state law to obtain reimbursement from certain classes of policyholders.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires filing of management and service contracts with director upon request, examination of records, and contract notice.

headings.title: Filing management contracts with director upon request
headings.reviewNote: Requires domestic insurers to file copies of management and service contracts upon written request of director.

headings.title: Examination of managing entity books and records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to examine books and accounts of managing entity to extent related to insurer transactions.

headings.title: Prohibition on financially detrimental management contracts
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits management contracts from operating to the financial detriment of the insurer in a manner endangering financial stability or hazardous to policyholders and creditors.

headings.title: Director enforcement proceedings under section 374.046
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to proceed under section 374.046 upon finding on examination that a management contract violates this section.

headings.title: Five-day notice to director of management contract
headings.reviewNote: Requires any person, organization, or corporation holding a subsection 1 management contract to notify the director within five days of execution.

entries.reviewSummary: Caps domestic insurance corporation organization expenses at ten percent of stock-sale proceeds payable from surplus with subscriber consent, bars pre-licensing officer salaries, and applies limits to stock increases.

headings.title: Ten percent ceiling on organization expenses
headings.reviewNote: Restricts incorporation, promotional, and organizing expenses to ten percent of proceeds from capital stock sales.

headings.title: Subscriber written consent and payment from surplus
headings.reviewNote: Requires stock subscribers' written consent for organization expenses payable out of corporate surplus, with the 10% cap covering stock-sale commissions, rent, clerk hire, literature, and all pre-license expenses.

headings.title: Prohibition on officer salaries prior to licensing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits any company officer from drawing a salary before the corporation is fully organized and licensed to do business.

headings.title: Application of expense and consent limits to stock increases
headings.reviewNote: Allows existing domestic insurance corporations to increase capital stock subject to the same sales-expense cap and subscriber written-consent restrictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes director judicial proceedings against hazardous promotions, appointment of receiver, and receiver compensation.

headings.title: Injunction proceedings against hazardous company promotions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to institute circuit court injunction proceedings against organizing companies hazardous to the public.

headings.title: Appointment of director or receiver by court
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to appoint director or other suitable person as receiver to wind up promotional affairs.

headings.title: Court approval and payment of receiver compensation
headings.reviewNote: Requires receiver compensation to be fair and reasonable, approved by court, and paid from company assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines statutory residency of domestic and foreign insurance companies for venue and legal purposes.

headings.title: Residency of domestic insurance companies
headings.reviewNote: Deems domestic insurance companies to reside in the Missouri county where registered office is maintained.

headings.title: Residency of foreign insurance companies
headings.reviewNote: Deems foreign insurance companies to reside in registered office county or Cole County if lacking registered office.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes exclusive venue rules for court actions against insurance companies, governing contract disputes and motorist claims.

headings.title: Venue in actions regarding insurance contracts
headings.reviewNote: Places venue in county where insurer resides or county of insured residence when contract was issued.

headings.title: Exceptions for uninsured and underinsured motorist claims
headings.reviewNote: Exempts uninsured and underinsured motorist actions and assigns their venue to section 375.1806.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates corporate officers for domestic insurance companies, separate president and secretary roles, and authority sources.

headings.title: President and secretary required of insurance corporations
headings.reviewNote: Requires domestic insurers to have president and secretary chosen by directors, barring one person holding both offices.

headings.title: Officer authority and management duties in bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Provides that officer authority and duties are governed by bylaws or board of directors resolutions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs voting by written proxy in domestic insurance companies and director rulemaking for stock insurer proxy solicitations.

headings.title: Proxy voting rights and written authorization requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes legal voters to cast votes by written proxy naming authorized person and meeting date.

headings.title: Director rulemaking authority for proxy solicitations
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to adopt rules governing proxy solicitations and authorizations by domestic stock insurers.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates share classes, preferred series issuances, consideration on conversions, and full payment before stock issuance.

headings.title: Power to create share classes and voting ratios
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes share classes with one-dollar par value minimum and caps nonvoting shares at two-to-one ratio.

headings.title: Issuance of preferred shares in series
headings.reviewNote: Governs preferred series terms, director approval, certificates filed with state, and equal class rights.

headings.title: Consideration determination on share conversions or exchanges
headings.reviewNote: Defines consideration for converted or exchanged shares as original consideration plus transferred surplus.

headings.title: Full-paid nonassessable shares and conclusive valuation
headings.reviewNote: Deems shares full-paid and nonassessable upon corporate receipt of consideration and makes board or shareholder valuation judgment conclusive absent actual fraud.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures for amending articles of incorporation, board resolutions, shareholder approval, and voting classes.

headings.title: Scope of permissible corporate charter amendments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic insurance corporations to amend articles of incorporation to alter corporate name, powers, or capital.

headings.title: Permissible charter amendments and one-dollar par minimum
headings.reviewNote: Lists eleven specific permissible charter amendments (including name, office, duration, purposes, directors, shares, par value, reclassification, and 2:1 nonvoting ratio cap) and sets a $1 minimum par value.

headings.title: Adoption procedure, notice, and majority voting
headings.reviewNote: Allows board resolution or direct submission to an annual or special meeting, prescribes written notice (or newspaper publication for mutuals), and requires majority approval of those entitled to vote (or voting members for mutuals).

entries.reviewSummary: Defines effective date of corporate charter amendments upon secretary of state certification and saves existing rights.

headings.title: Effective date of corporate charter amendment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that charter amendment takes effect upon issuance of certificate of amendment by secretary of state.

headings.title: Preservation of existing rights and pending actions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that amendment does not affect existing causes of action or pending proceedings involving corporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Specifies execution requirements, officer signatures, and mandatory contents for certificates of amendment of articles.

headings.title: Execution and verification of certificate of amendment
headings.reviewNote: Requires executing a certificate of amendment in triplicate by the president or vice president and secretary or assistant secretary, verified with corporate seal affixed (or by attorney in fact for reciprocal exchanges).

headings.title: Required contents of amendment certificate
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates certificate contents including corporation name, adopted amendment text, and shareholder vote tallies.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs restatement of corporate charter or articles of incorporation, required board resolution, and state approval.

headings.title: Procedure for restating articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic insurance companies to restate their charter, articles, or declaration of organization in the same manner provided for amendments in sections 375.201 through 375.221.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of restated articles
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director and secretary of state to issue a certificate of restated articles in lieu of the section 375.206 certificate of amendment.

headings.title: Legal effect of certified restated articles
headings.reviewNote: Provides that certified restated articles supersede original articles of incorporation for all future corporate purposes.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates reinsurance credit for domestic ceding insurers, accredited and certified reinsurers, trust funds, and collateral.

headings.title: Reinsurance credit categories, certification, and concentration notices
headings.reviewNote: Governs domestic ceding insurer credit across licensed, accredited, substantially similar domiciliary, trusteed, certified, reciprocal-jurisdiction, and mandatory-jurisdiction reinsurers, plus jurisdiction/trust clauses, accreditation suspension, and 50% recoverable or 20% ceded-premium concentration notices.

headings.title: Liability reduction for collateralized non-qualifying reinsurers
headings.reviewNote: Allows asset or liability reduction up to carried liabilities for reinsurance ceded to non-subsection-1 reinsurers when secured in the United States by cash, SVO-listed securities, clean irrevocable letters of credit, or director-approved security.

headings.title: Definitions of qualified United States financial institution
headings.reviewNote: Defines qualified United States financial institution separately for issuers/confirmers of letters of credit and for institutions eligible to act as trust fiduciaries.

headings.title: General and product-specific reinsurance credit rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Grants general rulemaking authority and specific rulemaking for nonlevel life, universal life secondary guarantees, variable annuities, long-term care, and NAIC model products using the section 376.380(6) valuation manual, with large, certified, and reciprocal reinsurer exemptions.

headings.title: Disallowance of deceptive reinsurance and insolvency clause
headings.reviewNote: Disallows credit for deceptive or no-risk-transfer reinsurance (4-month cancellation prima facie deceptive) and requires reinsurance to be payable without diminution on insolvency, with direct-payment exceptions, life/health guaranty election, and reinsurer defense rights.

headings.title: Post-liquidation reinsurer security and credit disallowance
headings.reviewNote: Requires reinsurers of liquidated insurers to continue posting contractually required letters of credit or security for reserves and allows the director to disallow future Missouri reinsurance credit for noncompliance.

headings.title: Inapplicability of vexatious refusal statute to reinsurance
headings.reviewNote: Excludes actions by a ceding insurer against an assuming insurer under a Missouri-compliant reinsurance contract from section 375.420.

headings.title: Conformity with NAIC or director-approved accounting principles
headings.reviewNote: Limits domestic insurer reinsurance credit to amounts allowed by consistent application of NAIC statutory accounting principles or other director-approved accounting principles.

headings.title: Suspension of reinsurer accreditation, approval, or certification
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to suspend a reinsurer's subsection 1 accreditation, approval, or certification for noncompliance after notice and opportunity for hearing.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes civil actions by and against insurance companies and suits by policyholders against mutual insurers.

headings.title: Civil actions by insurer against members or stockholders
headings.reviewNote: Permits Missouri insurance corporations to maintain civil actions against members or stockholders for any cause relating to company business.

headings.title: Member or stockholder loss suits and exclusive dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Allows members or stockholders to sue for accrued policy losses withheld over two months after due, while barring anyone other than the director from bringing winding-up, dissolution, or asset-distribution actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs service of legal process upon the director of commerce and insurance, certified-mail forwarding and recordkeeping, and plaintiff's ten-day notice and compliance affidavit.

headings.title: Service of process upon insurance director
headings.reviewNote: Provides that service of process upon director is valid service upon foreign or domestic insurance companies.

headings.title: Director certification and plaintiff ten-day certified notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to certify receipt to the court clerk and deems service sufficient if plaintiff sends certified-mail notice and copies to defendant within 10 days and files the return receipt and compliance affidavit before appearance.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits acting for insolvent insurers, requires guarantee fund deposits, regulates capital advertising, and establishes penalties.

headings.title: Prohibition on acting for undercapitalized insurers
headings.reviewNote: Bars acting as agent, producer, or otherwise aiding an insurer unless it possesses the paid-up capital, premium notes, cash premiums, or guarantee fund required under chapter 375.

headings.title: Guarantee fund deposits for out-of-state companies
headings.reviewNote: Requires non-Missouri companies' guarantee funds to be deposited with the proper officer of their home state or country or with the Missouri director under section 379.050.

headings.title: Advertising restrictions on capital and assets
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that advertisements state only actual paid-up cash capital and specify assets available for losses.

headings.title: Administrative orders and level two violation penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies violations as level two.

headings.title: Civil actions for enforcement of advertising restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to maintain civil action under section 374.048 for violations of section requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits unauthorized insurance business, establishes administrative orders, civil actions, felony penalties, and prosecution referrals.

headings.title: Prohibition on unauthorized transaction of insurance
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to transact insurance business in Missouri without certificate of authority or statutory exemption.

headings.title: Administrative orders and level four penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies unauthorized transaction as level four.

headings.title: Civil injunctive actions for unauthorized insurance business
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to bring civil actions under section 374.048 to enjoin unauthorized insurance operations.

headings.title: Class E felony for knowing unauthorized insurance business
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly transacting unauthorized insurance business in Missouri as a class E felony.

headings.title: Criminal prosecution referral to prosecutors or attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to refer criminal evidence to local prosecuting attorneys or attorney general for prosecution.

headings.title: Preservation of criminal prosecution under other laws
headings.reviewNote: Preserves state power to prosecute and punish conduct constituting criminal offenses under other state statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits domestic insurance companies from trading in commercial merchandise, with exceptions for real estate operations.

headings.title: Prohibition against commercial trading in merchandise
headings.reviewNote: Bars domestic insurance companies from trading in goods or commodities except incident to authorized real estate.

headings.title: Exemption for life insurance companies under chapter 376
headings.reviewNote: Exempts life and accident insurance companies organized under chapter 376 from commercial trading prohibitions.

entries.reviewSummary: Permits property and casualty insurers to hold company motor vehicles as admitted assets, setting limits, amortization, and reciprocity.

headings.title: Motor vehicles admitted as company business assets
headings.reviewNote: Permits property and casualty insurers to hold motor vehicles as admitted assets up to two percent of assets.

headings.title: Prohibition on declaring personal use vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Bars insurers from claiming motor vehicles as admitted assets if vehicles are used for personal nonbusiness purposes.

headings.title: Reciprocal prohibition for foreign insurer vehicle assets
headings.reviewNote: Denies vehicle asset declaration to foreign insurers domiciled in states that refuse to grant reciprocal recognition.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes exclusive authorized categories for real estate ownership by domestic insurance companies and quantitative asset caps.

headings.title: Permitted purposes for purchasing and holding real estate
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates eight permissible purposes including business accommodation, mortgaged security, debts, and income production.

headings.title: Authorized income-producing property investment categories
headings.reviewNote: Permits income-producing investments in existing or new industrial, commercial, and residential housing properties.

headings.title: Aggregate limitation on income-producing real estate
headings.reviewNote: Caps income-producing real estate under subsection 1(7) at 10% of admitted assets overall, and caps single-property or single-lessee holdings at the greater of 1% of admitted assets or 10% of capital and surplus.

headings.title: Prohibition on other holdings and ten-year disposal rule
headings.reviewNote: Bars holding real estate for unauthorized purposes and requires disposing of debt-payment or foreclosure real estate within 10 years of acquiring absolute title unless held under subsection 1(7).

headings.title: Director extension of foreclosure real estate holding period
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director, for good cause shown, to extend the holding period for debt-payment or foreclosure real estate in the best interests of policyholders.

headings.title: Deposit of real estate deeds by life insurers
headings.reviewNote: Allows life insurers depositing under section 376.170 to execute deeds for owned real estate to the director as trustee as approved security under sections 376.010 to 376.670.

headings.title: Exemption for insurers organized under chapter 376
headings.reviewNote: Exempts insurers organized under chapter 376 from the real estate restrictions of this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes insurers and benefit societies to accept purchaser stocks or bonds or exchange real estate when disposing of foreclosure or debt-acquired property, exempting chapter 376 insurers.

headings.title: Taking stocks, bonds, or exchanged realty on foreclosure sales
headings.reviewNote: Permits life insurers, benefit societies, and associations selling foreclosure or debt-acquired property to accept purchaser stocks or bonds in payment and exchange such real estate for other real estate.

headings.title: Exemption for insurers organized under chapter 376
headings.reviewNote: Exempts insurers organized under chapter 376 from this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes domestic insurer derivative transactions for hedging and income generation, internal guidelines, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Definitions for derivative instruments and transactions
headings.reviewNote: Defines twenty-two terms including admitted assets, counterparty exposure, derivative instrument, hedging transaction, income generation transaction, replication transaction, and underlying interest.

headings.title: Authorized hedging, income generation, and replication limits
headings.reviewNote: Permits hedging (subject to 7.5%, 3%, and 6.5% admitted-asset caps), income generation (10% cap), and rulemaking-conditioned replication transactions, aggregating counterparty exposure under single-entity limits.

headings.title: Board-approved written investment policies and records
headings.reviewNote: Requires board or authorized committee approval of written derivative investment policies and recordkeeping procedures prior to engaging in derivatives, with recorded committee minutes and regular board reports.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules for derivatives
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to adopt administrative rules governing insurer derivative use and accounting under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs domestic insurance corporation reacquisition of its own capital stock, prior director approval, and capital requirements.

headings.title: Prior director approval for reacquiring own stock
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits purchasing or holding own issued stock without prior director approval upon written application (copied to seller), except assessment forfeitures, and makes willful false statements a felony punishable by two to five years imprisonment.

headings.title: Exception for repurchases maintaining minimum capital
headings.reviewNote: Allows stock reacquisition without prior director approval if minimum capital and surplus remain intact and acquisitions exceeding 5% of any class in a three-month period are reported within 10 days after quarter-end.

headings.title: Exclusion of reacquired stock from admitted assets
headings.reviewNote: Bars counting reacquired, purchased, pledged, or held own shares as admitted assets or in determining insurer solvency.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs director approval for corporate acquisition of control of domestic insurance companies and public hearing procedures.

headings.title: Director approval to form subsidiary or acquire insurer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri insurers, with prior director approval, to organize majority-owned subsidiary insurers or acquire control of another insurer for common-control operations.

headings.title: Petition, newspaper notice, hearing, and approval standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires petitioning the director, publishing two-week newspaper notice to policyholders and stockholders, conducting examination and hearing, applying policyholder-protection and competition standards, and charging expenses to petitioners.

headings.title: Deposit eligibility of subsidiary life insurer shares
headings.reviewNote: Allows parent chapter 376 life insurers to deposit subsidiary life insurer shares under section 376.170 up to the proportional value of eligible cash or securities.

headings.title: Threshold exemptions for out-of-state insurer acquisitions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts acquisitions or dispositions of majority stock in non-Missouri insurers below consideration thresholds (3% consolidated assets/20% equity for holding companies; 3% assets/10% capital and surplus for domestic insurers).

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits dividend payments from capital or required surplus, establishing director penalties and stockholder liability.

headings.title: Prohibition against dividend payment from capital
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits domestic insurance companies from declaring or paying dividends except out of earned surplus profits.

headings.title: Dissolution proceedings for violating companies
headings.reviewNote: Subjects any insurance company violating subsection 1 dividend or impaired-business restrictions to proceedings for dissolution.

headings.title: Stockholder liability to return unlawful dividends
headings.reviewNote: Holds stockholders liable to creditors for illegal dividends with compound interest and collection costs, and punishes assenting directors/managers and knowing agents under sections 375.010 to 375.920.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates director investigation of corporate officer misconduct and duty of prosecuting attorney to institute proceedings.

headings.title: Director inquiry into insurer investments and records
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director, as often as deemed proper, to investigate how insurer money, funds, or securities are invested or employed and record results for policyholder and public-official inspection.

headings.title: Duty of prosecuting attorney upon director referral
headings.reviewNote: Directs prosecuting attorneys to institute civil or criminal proceedings upon referral of evidence by director.

entries.reviewSummary: Limits insurer retention of application prepayments to sixty days without policy or binder issuance, requires refund by negotiable instrument, preserves underwriting and rescission rights, and makes violations unfair trade practices.

headings.title: Definitions of insurer and covered policy types
headings.reviewNote: Defines insurer and seven covered noncommercial, individual, and non-employer group policy types for purposes of prepayment return rules.

headings.title: Sixty-day limit on retaining application prepayments
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits retaining application prepayments (except current membership dues) over 60 days unless the insurer issues and delivers the policy or a binder, conditional receipt, or temporary agreement.

headings.title: Refund by negotiable instrument within sixty days
headings.reviewNote: Requires refunding sums due under this section by negotiable instrument payable on demand delivered on or before the 60th day after application.

headings.title: Right to issue policy conditionally after refund
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that refunding prepayment does not bar an insurer from later deciding on the application and issuing the policy conditionally upon payment.

headings.title: Preservation of rescission and cancellation rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not affect an insurer's right to void a policy from inception for application misrepresentation or affect policy cancellation laws.

headings.title: Unfair trade practice classification for violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies any violation of this section as an unfair trade practice subject to sections 375.930 to 375.948.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes exemptions from insider trading reporting rules for registered equity securities, market makers, and defines equity securities.

headings.title: Exemption for over-the-counter market-maker dealers
headings.reviewNote: Exempts dealer purchases and sales of non-investment-account equity securities made in the ordinary course of establishing or maintaining a non-exchange primary or secondary market from sections 375.423 and 375.424.

headings.title: Exemption for foreign or domestic arbitrage transactions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts foreign or domestic arbitrage transactions from sections 375.422 to 375.424 unless made in contravention of director rules.

headings.title: Exemptions for Exchange Act registered or closely held shares
headings.reviewNote: Exempts equity securities registered under Section 12 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 or of insurers with fewer than 100 holders of record of any class at prior year-end.

headings.title: Definition and scope of equity security
headings.reviewNote: Defines equity security to include stock, convertible securities, warrants, rights, and similar instruments.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits fraudulent business conduct, bad faith claims practices, and establishes administrative orders, penalties, and civil actions.

headings.title: Prohibited fraudulent conduct and bad faith practices
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to conduct business fraudulently, breach contracts in bad faith, or habitually force claim litigation.

headings.title: Administrative orders level two penalties and license revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director administrative orders under section 374.046, level two violation penalties, and license revocation.

headings.title: Civil actions for fraudulent and bad faith conduct
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to maintain civil action under section 374.048 for improper business practices.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates statutory deposits received by director, dual-key vault custody, interest collection, asset substitutions, and garnishment immunity.

headings.title: Director duty to receive statutory securities deposits
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to receive required securities deposits and issue official vouchers to depositing insurance companies.

headings.title: Maintenance of deposits at full statutory value
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to ensure companies maintain deposits at full actual value required by law at all times.

headings.title: Dual-key deposit box custody and opening procedures
headings.reviewNote: Mandates iron box custody requiring two distinct keys held by director and company, with court orders upon insolvency.

headings.title: Storage of deposit boxes in designated bank vault
headings.reviewNote: Directs storage in designated bank vault with company paying safekeeping fees for deposit boxes.

headings.title: Company right to receive interest and substitute securities
headings.reviewNote: Permits solvent company to collect interest and dividends and substitute securities of equivalent value.

headings.title: Immunity of director deposits from garnishment or attachment
headings.reviewNote: Shields statutory deposits held by director from garnishment, attachment, or unauthorized legal process.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates securities deposit withdrawals upon business relinquishment, newspaper publication, and liability extinguishment exams.

headings.title: Newspaper publication of intent to withdraw deposits
headings.reviewNote: Requires published notice in local newspaper twice weekly for six weeks upon intent to withdraw deposits.

headings.title: Examination of debts before delivery of securities
headings.reviewNote: Directs director examination to verify all policyholder liabilities are satisfied before releasing deposited securities.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes court orders directing deposit sales to satisfy unpaid policy judgments, solvency stays, and receiver settlements.

headings.title: Sale of deposited securities to satisfy judgments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court order directing director to sell deposited securities to pay unsatisfied execution judgments.

headings.title: Ten-day duty to replenish withdrawn securities
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to proceed against a company as insolvent or unsound unless it replenishes disposed securities with like kind and value within 10 days.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs distribution of deposited securities to policyholders upon dissolution or insolvency, capping creditor recoveries.

headings.title: Distribution of deposited securities to policyholders
headings.reviewNote: Requires deposited securities of dissolved insurer to be distributed ratably among its policyholder claimants.

headings.title: General-asset sharing and registered-policy deposit priority
headings.reviewNote: Allows unpaid policy claimants to share in general assets for unpaid balances without offset for deposit proceeds, while applying registered-policy and annuity-bond deposits first to those obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Retains statutory deposits with the director for reinsured policyholders of insolvent companies, defines assuming reinsurer rights and duties, and governs priority if the reinsurer becomes insolvent.

headings.title: Retention of deposits for reinsured company policyholders
headings.reviewNote: Keeps deposited securities of a reinsured insolvent company with the director for its policyholders while policies remain in force, granting the reinsurer substitution and interest rights and imposing corresponding liabilities.

headings.title: Priority of reinsured policyholders upon reinsurer insolvency
headings.reviewNote: Directs that if the reinsuring company becomes insolvent, net deposit proceeds pay policy claims against the reinsured company first, with any remainder going to the reinsuring company's general assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Limits court proceedings costs paid from deposited securities and requires court approval for expense allowances.

headings.title: Court costs payable from deposited securities
headings.reviewNote: Limits deposit liability exclusively to actual collection costs and up to 1% of proved and allowed policies as full compensation for actuaries, clerks, and appointees settling claims.

headings.title: Limitation on total cost allowances from deposits
headings.reviewNote: Caps deposit collection costs at actual amounts paid out, not to exceed 2.5% of the amount collected, paid from deposit proceeds with court approval.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes non-chapter-376 domestic insurers to invest in high-grade United States institutional debt and preferred stock and defines institution.

headings.title: Authorized investment in institutional debt obligations
headings.reviewNote: Permits domestic insurers to invest in debt obligations of solvent United States business institutions.

headings.title: Definition of qualifying business institution
headings.reviewNote: Defines institution as a corporation, joint stock company, association, trust, business partnership, business joint venture, or similar entity.

headings.title: Exemption for insurers organized under chapter 376
headings.reviewNote: Exempts insurers organized under chapter 376 from this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes domestic insurer investments in foreign government and corporate securities, aggregate asset caps, and currency limits.

headings.title: Authorized investments in foreign government securities
headings.reviewNote: Permits Missouri insurers with at least $100 million in admitted assets to invest in qualifying foreign government or corporate securities up to 20% of admitted assets overall and 10% (SVO 1) or 5% (other) per foreign jurisdiction, aggregated with U.S. class limits.

headings.title: Exemption for insurers organized under chapter 376
headings.reviewNote: Exempts insurers organized under chapter 376 from this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines impaired insurer, mandates immediate officer notice to director, and establishes criminal penalties for concealment.

headings.title: Definition of impaired insurer for notification
headings.reviewNote: Defines impaired insurer as one whose capital or surplus is reduced below statutory minimum requirements.

headings.title: Mandatory officer notification of insurer impairment
headings.reviewNote: Requires chief executive, financial officer, or director to notify director immediately upon knowing of impairment.

headings.title: Officer, director, and trustee duty to notify CEO
headings.reviewNote: Requires any officer, director, or trustee who knows or has reason to know an insurer is impaired to notify the chief executive officer.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for nonnotification and insolvency fraud
headings.reviewNote: Punishes knowing or reckless notification violations by up to $50,000 fine and/or one year imprisonment, and classifies knowing asset concealment, transfer, record falsification, or court-proceeding bribery contributing to insolvency as a class E felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory standards for determining hazardous financial operations, corrective director orders, and hearing rights.

headings.title: Single net retained risk threshold for hazardous condition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes deeming a property or casualty insurer hazardous if any in-force policy carries a single net retained risk exceeding 10% of prior December 31 capital and surplus.

headings.title: Twenty standards for determining hazardous operation
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates twenty financial, actuarial, reinsurance, operating-loss, management-fitness, liquidity, underreserving, and affiliate-transaction standards for evaluating hazardous insurer operations.

headings.title: Director adjustments in evaluating financial condition
headings.reviewNote: Permits the director to disregard insolvent-reinsurer credits, adjust affiliate asset values, disallow speculative receivables, and add probable 12-month contingent liabilities.

headings.title: Corrective action orders for hazardous insurers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering twelve corrective measures including reinsurance, volume limits, expense reductions, capital increases, dividend suspension, governance fixes, business plans, and nonlife rate adjustments.

headings.title: Private chapter 536 hearing on hazardous orders
headings.reviewNote: Grants insurers a chapter 536 hearing held 10 to 30 days after section 536.067 notice, conducted privately unless the insurer requests a public hearing.

headings.title: Non-limitation of powers and foreign insurer scope
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section neither limits nor supersedes other state laws, noting statutory limits applicable to orders against foreign insurers.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs commencement of delinquency proceedings by director, verified petition contents, statutory grounds, and injunction prayers.

headings.title: Incorporation of section 375.1152 definitions
headings.reviewNote: Applies the definitions in section 375.1152 to terms used in sections 375.570 to 375.750.

headings.title: Commencement by verified petition and general relief prayer
headings.reviewNote: Directs commencing formal delinquency or section 375.1164 seizure proceedings by verified petition in the director's name stating condition or causes and concluding with a prayer for general relief.

headings.title: Prayer for preliminary injunctions and restraining orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes petition to pray for temporary restraining orders enjoining business operations and asset transfers.

headings.title: Prior notice to insurer before preliminary orders
headings.reviewNote: Directs that reasonable advance notice be given to insurer before issuing preliminary orders whenever practicable.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs ex parte preliminary orders, ten-day return of summons, confidential court files, and bond exemption for director.

headings.title: Ex parte preliminary orders and summons return date
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ex parte preliminary orders, setting summons return within ten days and keeping file confidential.

headings.title: Public access where no preliminary order prayed
headings.reviewNote: Provides that court files are open to public where petition does not request ex parte preliminary orders.

headings.title: Exemption of director from injunction bond
headings.reviewNote: Exempts director from giving bonds for costs or damages in injunction proceedings or appellate reviews.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates summary hearings upon return of summons, alternative service, default judgments, and trial scheduling.

headings.title: Application of general civil practice rules
headings.reviewNote: Provides that pleadings and proceedings are governed by civil practice rules except as otherwise regulated by statute.

headings.title: Summary hearing on return date of summons
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuit court to hold summary hearing on date and time designated for return of summons.

headings.title: Procedures upon defendant failure to appear
headings.reviewNote: Governs alternative service, hearing continuances, and default judgments if defendant fails to appear.

headings.title: Procedures upon defendant appearance at summary hearing
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to require answer, review preliminary orders, and set trial date within ten days of appearance.

headings.title: Published notice upon second failure to appear
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes published notice and default judgment if defendant fails to appear after reasonable service efforts.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires prompt non-jury trial or master reference, strict continuance limits, expedited discovery, and evidence exclusions.

headings.title: Non-jury trial or reference to special master
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to determine cause without jury or refer hearing to master upon motion of director.

headings.title: Strict limits on continuances and discovery rules
headings.reviewNote: Restricts continuances to death or serious illness, limits discovery, and establishes evidentiary presumptions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs master proceedings, ten-day report filing deadline, removal for delay, master fees, and exceptions.

headings.title: Ten-day report deadline for special master
headings.reviewNote: Requires special master to proceed with hearing and file report within ten days after testimony concludes.

headings.title: Removal of master for delay and fees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to remove master failing to proceed promptly without compensation and taxes master fees as costs.

headings.title: Exceptions to master report and court determination
headings.reviewNote: Allows parties three days to file exceptions to master report, which court determines without delay.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes self-authenticated prima facie evidentiary status of exam reports, fifteen-day decision deadlines, appeal procedures, and good-faith defense attorney fee standards.

headings.title: Evidentiary status of official examination reports
headings.reviewNote: Deems certified department examination reports prima facie evidence of insurer condition and affairs.

headings.title: Fifteen-day or ten-day deadline for court decision
headings.reviewNote: Requires the court to decide the case within 15 days after conclusion of evidence, or within 10 days after filing objections to a referee or master report.

headings.title: Director right to appeal judgment for defendant
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to appeal if the court's finding is in favor of the defendant.

headings.title: Plaintiff judgment, five-day defendant appeal, and no stay
headings.reviewNote: Directs entry of sections 375.1150 to 375.1246 relief for plaintiff, allows defendant appeal perfected within five days with court-fixed bond, and bars appeals or supersedeas bonds from dissolving the court's order.

headings.title: Discretionary fee allowances based on good faith
headings.reviewNote: Conditions allowance of defense attorney fees from assets upon good faith defense of delinquency petition.

entries.reviewSummary: Vests insolvent insurer assets in the director as receiver, authorizes court-approved special deputy receivers with judicial immunity, and limits application to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings.

headings.title: Vesting of asset title in director as receiver
headings.reviewNote: Vests director with absolute title to all property, assets, books, and papers of insurer upon decree.

headings.title: Appointment and powers of special deputy receiver
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to appoint special deputy receiver to take charge of assets and perform receiver duties.

headings.title: Applicability limited to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Restricts section 375.650 strictly to proceedings instituted before August 28, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes receiver collection of insurer debts, liquidation of assets, settlement of claims, and real property conveyances.

headings.title: Receiver powers to collect debts and sell property
headings.reviewNote: Empowers receiver to collect debts, compromise doubtful claims, and sell real and personal property with court approval.

headings.title: Applicability limited to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Restricts section 375.660 strictly to proceedings instituted before August 28, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates receiver review and allowance of claims, hearing of disputed demands, and reports of disallowed claims.

headings.title: Court claims procedures, deadlines, and bar of late claims
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court on receiver application to establish claims procedures, set or extend claim-filing deadlines, and direct notice, barring creditors who fail to timely present claims.

headings.title: Receiver review, priority classification, and contested claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires receiver review, consent with section 375.700 priority classification and first-class mail notice, or objection subject to section 375.1214.

headings.title: Applicability limited to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Restricts section 375.670 strictly to proceedings instituted before August 28, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits knowing refusal to deliver insurer assets to the director, authorizes administrative orders, civil actions, level three penalties, class D felony sanctions with license revocation, and criminal referrals.

headings.title: Prohibition on refusing to deliver insurer assets
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to knowingly neglect or refuse to deliver insurer books, papers, evidences of title or debt, or property to the director on order or demand.

headings.title: Administrative orders, level three penalties, and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes section 374.046 administrative orders, classifies violations as level three under section 374.049, and permits license or certificate suspension or revocation for willful violations.

headings.title: Civil actions for refusal to deliver assets
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to maintain civil actions under section 374.048 and classifies violations as level three under section 374.049.

headings.title: Class D felony and mandatory license revocation
headings.reviewNote: Makes knowing violation of this section a class D felony and directs the sentencing court to order revocation of any Missouri insurance license or certificate of authority.

headings.title: Criminal referral to prosecutor or attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to refer available evidence to the prosecuting attorney or attorney general under section 27.030 for criminal proceedings.

headings.title: Preservation of criminal prosecution under general law
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that penalties do not bar prosecution for other criminal offenses committed during transaction.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs court approval and payment of receivership administrative expenses, receiver compensation, and state reimbursements.

headings.title: Prohibition on personal fees for director
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the director shall receive no fees or compensation for personal services performed in delinquency proceedings.

headings.title: Compensation of special deputy receivers and counsel
headings.reviewNote: Requires compensation of special deputy receivers, attorneys, and accountants to be approved by court.

headings.title: Annual court accounting and official bond liability
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to keep full accounts of receipts and disbursements, report to the court at least every 12 months, and remain responsible on official bond for assets.

headings.title: Court discretion to require additional director bond
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court, in its discretion, to require the director to furnish a bond in addition to the official bond.

headings.title: Applicability limited to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Restricts section 375.740 strictly to proceedings instituted prior to August 28, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires semiannual sworn receiver reports to the court, authorizes court-ordered distributions at a ten percent cash threshold, and limits application to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings.

headings.title: Periodic receiver financial reports to court
headings.reviewNote: Requires receiver to submit periodic financial reports of receipts, assets, and liabilities to supervising court.

headings.title: Court orders for payment of dividend distributions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to order partial or final dividend distributions to claimants as funds become available.

headings.title: Applicability limited to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Restricts section 375.750 strictly to proceedings instituted prior to August 28, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates Missouri Property and Casualty Insurance Guaranty Association, mandatory insurer membership, and statutory definitions.

headings.title: Creation and membership of guaranty association
headings.reviewNote: Creates nonprofit legal entity requiring all licensed property and casualty insurers to remain members.

headings.title: Definitions for property casualty guaranty association
headings.reviewNote: Defines claimant, covered claim, insolvent insurer, member insurer, net worth, and net direct written premiums.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes four separate administrative accounts in guaranty association and lists excluded lines of insurance.

headings.title: Four separate administrative accounts of association
headings.reviewNote: Divides association into workers compensation, automobile, Missouri mutual, and other insurance accounts.

headings.title: Lines of insurance excluded from guaranty coverage
headings.reviewNote: Excludes life, annuity, mortgage guaranty, fidelity, surety, credit, warranty, title, and ocean marine lines.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes certificates of contribution for member assessments, asset amortizations, premium tax offsets, and tax exemption.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of contribution to insurers
headings.reviewNote: Requires association to issue certificates of contribution to member insurers paying statutory assessments.

headings.title: Carrying contribution certificate as admitted asset
headings.reviewNote: Permits insurer to show certificate as admitted asset amortized over three years at declining percentages.

headings.title: Premium tax credit for association assessments
headings.reviewNote: Entitles insurer to tax credit against premium tax liability equal to one-third of assessment over three years.

headings.title: Remittance of recovered tax write-offs to state
headings.reviewNote: Requires association to pay recovered funds previously offset against taxes to the director of revenue.

headings.title: Exemption of association from state and local taxes
headings.reviewNote: Exempts association from payment of state and local fees and taxes, declaring property charitable.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates comprehensive statutory powers and duties of guaranty association, covered claim limits, assessments, and defenses.

headings.title: Guaranty association covered claim payment obligations
headings.reviewNote: Obligates association to pay covered claims up to full workers compensation, twenty-five thousand unearned premium, and three hundred thousand other.

headings.title: Claim information form filing and net worth bar
headings.reviewNote: Requires claim information form, bar for insureds exceeding twenty-five million net worth, and eighteen-month deadline.

headings.title: Bodily injury award limits and itemized verdicts
headings.reviewNote: Limits bodily injury, sickness, or disease awards to medical/spiritual healing expenses, lost earnings, and necessary replacement services (except full workers' compensation) and requires itemized verdicts.

headings.title: Inapplicability of subsection 3 after August 31, 2004
headings.reviewNote: Exempts claims arising from member insurers subject to final liquidation orders dated on or after August 31, 2004 from subsection 3 limits.

headings.title: Ten-million-dollar aggregate cap per insured and affiliates
headings.reviewNote: Terminates association obligations (except workers' compensation) once $10 million aggregate has been paid across all state guaranty associations for an insured and its affiliates under one insolvent insurer.

headings.title: Equitable allocation plan for multiple claimants
headings.reviewNote: Permits the association to establish an equitable allocation plan when multiple claimants hold covered or allowed claims under one insurer's policies.

headings.title: Deemed insurer status, subrogation, and defense termination
headings.reviewNote: Deems the association the insurer to the extent of covered claim obligations (with salvage/subrogation rights, excluding personal jurisdiction) and ends the duty to defend upon payment or tender of limits.

headings.title: Four-account allocation and member insurer assessments
headings.reviewNote: Requires separate four-account claim allocation and proportional member assessments (30-day notice, 2% annual cap, proration, deferment with dividend ban, and claim-payment setoffs).

headings.title: Servicing facilities, examination, March 30 report, and claims
headings.reviewNote: Directs the association to handle claims via staff or director-approved servicing facilities, reimburse facilities, submit to examination with a March 30 annual financial report, and investigate and settle covered claims.

headings.title: Permissive litigation, borrowing, contract, and refund powers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes defending/appealing actions, employing staff, acting as servicing facility, borrowing funds, suing/intervening, contracting, refunding excess account assets, and joining the NCIGF.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs selection and composition of association board of directors, terms, approval, vacancies, and expense reimbursement.

headings.title: Board duties, plan of operation, and member appeals
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board, under director supervision, to establish a plan of operation, asset and recordkeeping procedures, meeting schedules, 30-day member appeal rights to the director, and board selection procedures.

headings.title: Delegation of association duties to multi-state organization
headings.reviewNote: Permits delegating association powers (except section 375.775(8) and (10)(4)) to an equivalent multi-state organization with board and director approval.

headings.title: Board size, domestic representation, selection, and vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Sets a seven-to-nine-member board (at least four domestic insurer representatives) selected by member insurers subject to director approval, with vacancies filled by remaining members subject to director approval.

headings.title: Prohibition on board member remuneration
headings.reviewNote: Provides that members of the association's board of directors shall receive no remuneration.

headings.title: Insolvency detection, nonpublic reports, and post-insolvency report
headings.reviewNote: Requires majority-vote notice to the director of potentially insolvent or hazardous members, authorizes nonpublic solvency recommendations, and mandates a post-insolvency history and causes report.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines regulatory powers and duties of insurance director regarding guaranty association oversight, insolvencies, and notices.

headings.title: Director duties on insolvency notice, premiums, and agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to notify the association within three days of insolvency notice, provide member net direct written premium statements upon board request, and notify the insolvent insurer's agents.

headings.title: Requiring agents to mail insolvency notice to insureds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to require agents who received subsection 1 notice to mail prompt written notice to each insured of record.

headings.title: Unlawful nonpayment of assessments or plan noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Makes failure to pay a due assessment or comply with the plan of operation unlawful, with each day of nonpayment constituting a separate violation.

headings.title: Administrative orders, level two penalties, and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes section 374.046 administrative orders, classifies violations as level two under section 374.049, and permits license or certificate suspension or revocation for willful violations.

headings.title: Director civil actions for guaranty assessment violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to maintain civil actions under section 374.048 and classifies violations as level two under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs subrogation rights upon claim payment, high net worth recoveries, automatic litigation stays, and records access.

headings.title: Exhaustion of other insurance policies and liability offset
headings.reviewNote: Requires claimants to first exhaust other insurance policies (including liability, health, HMO, self-insured, workers' comp, disability, and UM/UIM), reducing association obligations and insured liability by amounts recovered or recoverable.

headings.title: Order of recovery among multiple state guaranty associations
headings.reviewNote: Requires seeking recovery first from the guaranty association of the insured's residence (or property location for first-party property, or claimant's residence for workers' compensation), offsetting other guaranty recoveries.

headings.title: Exhaustion of governmental insurance or guaranty programs
headings.reviewNote: Requires exhausting claims against governmental insurance or guaranty programs first, reducing association payments by the recovery amount.

headings.title: No duty to provide separate coverage-issue defense
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the association has no duty to provide a separate defense at its cost to an insolvent insurer's insured on issues arising out of section coverage.

headings.title: Assignment of policy rights, cooperation, and receiver statements
headings.reviewNote: Assigns recovering claimants' policy rights to the association, requires cooperation, and directs periodic filing of paid and anticipated claim statements with the receiver or liquidator.

headings.title: Stay of court proceedings until claim-filing deadline
headings.reviewNote: Stays all Missouri court proceedings involving an insolvent insurer until the claim-filing deadline plus court-determined additional time, subject to association waiver in specific cases.

headings.title: Setting aside default judgments and defending on merits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the association to apply to set aside default judgments, orders, or verdicts based on an insolvent insurer's default or failure to defend and defend on the merits.

headings.title: Limit on property-damage subrogation against insolvent's insured
