headings.reviewNote: Limits a subrogating insurer's property-damage recovery against a tort-feasor insured by an insolvent insurer to insolvent-estate proceeds, except for damage exceeding policy limits.

headings.title: Guaranty association access to insolvent insurer records
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees association and servicing facilities access to books and records of insolvent insurer.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides civil immunity to guaranty association and employees, and classifies sales advertising of guaranty coverage as unfair trade.

headings.title: Civil immunity for association board and employees
headings.reviewNote: Shields association, member insurers, board, and employees from civil liability for actions taken under statute.

headings.title: Unfair trade practice for advertising guaranty coverage
headings.reviewNote: Classifies advertising guaranty association existence to induce policy sales as an unfair trade practice.

entries.reviewSummary: Makes willful violations of chapter 375 a class B misdemeanor unless otherwise specified, authorizes criminal referrals to prosecutors or the attorney general, and preserves other criminal laws.

headings.title: Class B misdemeanor for willful chapter 375 violations
headings.reviewNote: Makes willful violation of any provision of chapter 375 a crime, classified as a class B misdemeanor if not otherwise specifically provided.

headings.title: Criminal referral to prosecutor or attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to refer available evidence to the prosecuting attorney or attorney general under section 27.030 to institute criminal proceedings.

headings.title: Preservation of criminal prosecution under general law
headings.reviewNote: Preserves state authority to prosecute criminal conduct under other state statutory provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits unauthorized insurance business, lists transaction acts, statutory exemptions, administrative remedies, and penalties.

headings.title: Certificate of authority requirement for insurance
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transacting insurance business in Missouri without a certificate of authority, subject to ten statutory exemptions including surplus lines, reinsurance, out-of-state policies, industrial insureds, nonprofit institutional plans, and rental-vehicle coverages.

headings.title: Acts constituting transaction of insurance business
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates acts including contract making, premium collection, claim investigation, and policy delivery.

headings.title: Contract validity, suit bar, and procurer personal liability
headings.reviewNote: Preserves contract validity and defense rights of unauthorized insurers, bars them from suing in Missouri courts until authorized, and holds persons aiding procurement liable for unpaid claims or losses.

headings.title: Administrative cease and desist orders for violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to issue administrative cease and desist orders under section 374.046 for unauthorized operations.

headings.title: Civil actions and injunctive relief in circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to bring civil action under section 374.048 to enjoin unauthorized insurance business.

headings.title: Class D felony for unauthorized insurance business
headings.reviewNote: Classifies transacting insurance business without a certificate of authority as a class D felony.

headings.title: Criminal prosecution referral to prosecuting attorney
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to transmit criminal evidence to prosecuting attorneys or attorney general for prosecution.

headings.title: Preservation of other criminal statutory remedies
headings.reviewNote: Preserves state authority to prosecute crimes under other state criminal laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Deems unauthorized insurance transactions an irrevocable appointment of the secretary of state for service of process, sets delivery, certified-mail, and compliance-affidavit procedures, imposes a forty-five-day default wait, and preserves other service methods.

headings.title: Irrevocable appointment of secretary of state for process
headings.reviewNote: Deems any unauthorized insurance transaction under section 375.786 an irrevocable appointment of the secretary of state to receive service of process in court or director administrative proceedings.

headings.title: Delivery of two copies and fee to secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Specifies service by leaving two copies of process and paying the statutory fee to the secretary of state or person in apparent charge of the office.

headings.title: Certified-mail forwarding, ten-day notice, and compliance affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Requires the secretary of state to forward one copy by certified mail and keep records, and requires plaintiff or director to mail notice within 10 days and file the return receipt and compliance affidavit.

headings.title: Forty-five-day waiting period before default judgment
headings.reviewNote: Bars default judgments or administrative determinations until 45 days after filing the compliance affidavit.

headings.title: Preservation of other lawful methods of service
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not limit serving process, notices, orders, or demands in any other legally permitted manner.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires unauthorized insurers served under section 375.788 to post security or obtain a certificate of authority before pleading, allows administrative postponements, and preserves motions to quash service.

headings.title: Bond deposit or certification requirement before pleading
headings.reviewNote: Requires unauthorized insurer to post cash deposit, bond, or obtain certificate of authority before filing pleadings.

headings.title: Director postponement in administrative proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director in administrative proceedings served under section 375.788 to order a postponement giving the defendant reasonable opportunity to comply and defend.

headings.title: Preservation of motion to quash or set aside service
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not prevent an unauthorized insurer from moving to quash or set aside section 375.788 service on the ground it did not commit section 375.786 acts.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs enforcement of out-of-state regulatory decrees against unauthorized insurers, filing, notices, stays, and fines.

headings.title: Attorney general enforcement in Missouri or reciprocal states
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the attorney general, on director request, to proceed in Missouri or reciprocal-state courts to enforce court or director administrative orders.

headings.title: Definitions of foreign decree, qualified party, and reciprocal state
headings.reviewNote: Defines foreign decree, qualified party, and reciprocal state for interstate enforcement of insurance regulatory decrees.

headings.title: Director duty to maintain list of reciprocal states
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to determine which states and territories qualify as reciprocal states and maintain an up-to-date list.

headings.title: Enforcement and five thousand dollar money cap
headings.reviewNote: Gives filed foreign decree same effect as circuit court decree, capping money judgment enforcement at five thousand dollars.

headings.title: Clerk notice of filing foreign decree to defendant
headings.reviewNote: Requires court clerk to mail notice of decree filing to defendant and director, staying execution for thirty days.

headings.title: Stay of enforcement pending appeal or security
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes stay of foreign decree enforcement upon proof of pending appeal and posted security.

headings.title: Filing fees for foreign decree registration
headings.reviewNote: Sets fifty-dollar clerk filing fee for registering foreign decrees against unauthorized companies.

headings.title: Monetary fine for unauthorized insurance transactions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes fine up to five thousand dollars against unauthorized insurers transacting unauthorized business.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes admission requirements for foreign insurance companies and mandates certificate of authority before business.

headings.title: Admission requirements for foreign insurance companies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes admission of foreign stock, mutual, assessment, or reciprocal insurers meeting domestic requirements.

headings.title: Certificate of authority required for admitted business
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits foreign insurers from doing business in Missouri on an admitted basis without certificate of authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs annual July first renewal of foreign company certificate of authority, conditions, and twenty days notice of refusal.

headings.title: Annual July first renewal of certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual renewal of foreign company certificate of authority on July first upon tax and fee payment.

headings.title: Twenty days advance notice of refusal to renew
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to give twenty days written notice and opportunity for hearing before refusing renewal.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes application requirements, execution standards, and mandatory supporting documents for foreign insurer certificates of authority.

headings.title: Application contents for foreign certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign company to apply to director setting forth corporate domicile, lines, shares, and surplus.

headings.title: Form and officer execution of application
headings.reviewNote: Requires application on director forms executed by executive officers under verified corporate seal.

headings.title: Mandatory supporting documents delivered with application
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates attachments including certified charter, bylaws, process appointment, statements, and policy forms.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes prerequisite conditions for admitting foreign insurers and outlines factors considered by the director.

headings.title: Conditions precedent for foreign certificate issuance
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign applicant to prove lawful organization, distinct name, authorized lines, and capital.

headings.title: Pre-admission examination of foreign insurer condition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to examine the condition and affairs of a foreign insurance company before issuing a certificate of authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates foreign insurer corporate name changes, application for amended certificate of authority, and deceptive similarities.

headings.title: Application for amended certificate on name change
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign insurer changing corporate name to apply for amended certificate of authority.

headings.title: Form, execution, and contents of amended application
headings.reviewNote: Requires the amended certificate application to follow original application form and execution rules and state the company name, desired amendments, and necessary information.

headings.title: Director issuance of amended certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to issue an amended certificate if satisfied the company may lawfully transact the requested kinds of business and complies with section 375.821.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs merger of foreign insurers, document filings with director, and application for amended certificate of authority.

headings.title: Filing merger documents with insurance director
headings.reviewNote: Requires a surviving foreign insurer in a non-section-375.241 statutory merger to forthwith file authenticated merger documents and financial statements of any non-admitted merging companies.

headings.title: Application for amended certificate upon merger
headings.reviewNote: Directs surviving foreign insurer to apply for amended certificate if merger alters authorized insurance lines.

headings.title: Surrender of certificate by merged foreign company
headings.reviewNote: Requires nonsurviving foreign insurer to surrender its Missouri certificate of authority upon merger.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates withdrawal of admitted foreign insurance companies, application procedures, and liability discharge.

headings.title: Application for withdrawal of admitted foreign company
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes admitted foreign insurer to withdraw by filing formal application and statement of liabilities.

headings.title: Certificate cancellation upon filing and tax payment
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director, upon receiving the withdrawal statement, certificate of authority, and payment of any due taxes or charges, to cancel and return the certificate, terminating Missouri authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires annual statement filing by foreign insurers, reserve maintenance, and certificates in lieu of Missouri deposits.

headings.title: Foreign insurer statements, reserves, and deposit parity
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign insurers to file annual statements, maintain reserves, and make deposits in the same time and manner as domestic insurers transacting similar business.

headings.title: Out-of-state official deposit certificate in lieu of deposit
headings.reviewNote: Allows foreign insurers to file another state's official certificate confirming equivalent trust deposits (including a single multi-line certificate) in lieu of Missouri deposits.

headings.title: Director authority to require supplemental deposits or reserves
headings.reviewNote: Preserves the director's authority to require supplemental information, statements, deposits, and reserves necessary to protect Missouri policyholders.

headings.title: Non-release of company assets from Missouri liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that these sections do not release any assets of any company from any liability arising against it in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates trust agreements for foreign insurer deposits, trust asset location in United States, and director approval of amendments.

headings.title: Trust deposit maintenance in United States bank
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign insurers to maintain trust deposits in approved United States bank under written agreement.

headings.title: Qualified United States bank trustee and amendment approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires a qualified U.S. bank or trust company trustee, keeping assets continuously in the United States, written director approval for trust amendments, and corporate trustee substitution if individual trustees fall below three.

headings.title: Mandatory trust agreement terms and withdrawal exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires trust agreements to vest title in trustee, govern vacancies, keep assets separate in the U.S., regulate income remittances, and bar asset withdrawals without written director approval except for five specified purposes.

headings.title: Examination of trusteed assets and revocation for refusal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director examination of trusteed assets and trustee certification statements, making trustee refusal or neglect grounds for revoking the insurer's certificate of authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires foreign companies to transact business through licensed producers and regulates countersignature and commissions.

headings.title: Transaction of business through licensed producers
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign insurance companies to write and issue Missouri policies through licensed insurance producers.

headings.title: One-year authority revocation for violations
headings.reviewNote: Requires one-year revocation of authority to do business in Missouri for violating this section, in addition to section 375.310 penalties.

headings.title: Reciprocal countersignature rule for nonresident producers
headings.reviewNote: Eliminates resident countersignature on policies solicited by licensed nonresident agents or brokers unless their home state requires countersignature on policies solicited by Missouri residents.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires foreign insurers to irrevocably appoint the director for service of process, defines service delivery and covered actions, governs execution and authority forfeiture, and mandates mail forwarding and permanent records.

headings.title: Appointment of director as process attorney
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign insurance company to appoint director as true and lawful attorney to accept service of process.

headings.title: Delivery at Jefferson City and scope of covered actions
headings.reviewNote: Provides for delivering petition and summons to the director, deputy director, or chief clerk in Jefferson City, binding in specified resident and nonresident policy and Missouri-business actions.

headings.title: Service of associate circuit judge process
headings.reviewNote: Allows associate circuit judge process to be served by any authorized officer in the director's city or county at least 15 days before return.

headings.title: Instrument formalities and forfeiture of business authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate seal attestation, recital of this section, and board resolution with the appointment instrument, imposing forfeiture of Missouri business authority for noncompliance.

headings.title: First-class mail forwarding and permanent service record
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediately forwarding served process by prepaid first-class mail to the company secretary (or U.S. manager/general agent for alien insurers) and maintaining a permanent office record.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs redomestication of foreign insurers to Missouri, transfer of domestic insurers to other states, and director rulemaking.

headings.title: Redomestication of foreign insurer to Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes foreign insurer to become Missouri domestic insurer upon meeting organization and capital standards.

headings.title: Transfer of domestic insurer domicile to another state
headings.reviewNote: Permits Missouri domestic insurer to transfer domicile to another state with director approval.

headings.title: Continuation of corporate existence and policy obligations
headings.reviewNote: Provides that redomestication preserves corporate identity, contracts, assets, and liabilities without novation.

headings.title: Promulgation of insurer redomestication rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to adopt administrative rules implementing insurer redomestication procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Imposes retaliatory taxes, penalties, and fees on foreign insurers domiciled in states imposing excess burdens on Missouri insurers.

headings.title: Imposition of retaliatory taxes on foreign insurers
headings.reviewNote: Imposes equal retaliatory taxes and fees on foreign insurers whose home states impose higher burdens on Missouri companies.

headings.title: Payment to revenue director on estimated quarterly basis
headings.reviewNote: Requires paying all retaliatory licenses, fees, taxes, fines, and penalties to the director of revenue on an estimated quarterly basis under sections 148.310 to 148.461.

headings.title: Treatment of paid workers compensation losses
headings.reviewNote: Specifies calculation method for treating paid workers compensation losses in retaliatory tax determinations.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates insurer use of credit reports and insurance scores, adverse action notices, dispute rights, and scoring prohibitions.

headings.title: Definitions for insurance credit scoring regulation
headings.reviewNote: Defines adverse action, contract, credit report, credit scoring entity, and insurance credit score.

headings.title: Ban on adverse action based solely on credit
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits insurers using a credit report or insurance credit score in underwriting from taking adverse action without considering another noncredit-related underwriting factor.

headings.title: Adverse action based on inability to compute score
headings.reviewNote: Bars adverse action based on inability to compute an insurance credit score without considering another underwriting factor unless the insurer justifies the credibility of lacking a score to the director.

headings.title: Application disclosure of credit information gathering
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers using credit reports or insurance credit scores in underwriting to disclose at original application or on the application itself that credit information may be gathered.

headings.title: Ban on adverse action during credit-report disputes
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits adverse action based on credit-report information under written consumer dispute until final Fair Credit Reporting Act determination, extending section 375.002 or 379.110 60-day periods to 15 days after determination.

headings.title: Adverse action notice contents and dispute rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurer taking adverse action to identify credit agency and notify consumer of free report rights.

headings.title: Written request for specific statement of reasons
headings.reviewNote: Allows consumer within thirty days to request clear written statement of specific credit factors driving adverse action.

headings.title: Request for reunderwriting following credit correction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes applicant or insured to request reunderwriting within thirty days after credit errors are corrected.

headings.title: Three-year restriction on renewal adverse actions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits taking adverse action on renewal contracts based on credit until or after the third anniversary date.

headings.title: Prohibition against penalizing insurance credit inquiries
headings.reviewNote: Bars credit scoring models from treating insurance inquiries as negative underwriting factors.

headings.title: Construction with cancellation and financing provisions
headings.reviewNote: Preserves statutory cancellation laws and permits credit checks for premium financing plans.

headings.title: Prohibition on selling consumer credit inquiry lists
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits credit scoring entities from selling consumer expiration dates or inquiry lists to third parties.

headings.title: Administrative enforcement under section 374.280
headings.reviewNote: Provides that violations of credit scoring restrictions are enforceable under section 374.280.

headings.title: Effective date for credit scoring regulations
headings.reviewNote: Applies section requirements to all insurance contracts entered into on or after July 1, 2003.

entries.reviewSummary: Permits non-English policy documents, controlling effect of English text, required bilingual disclosures, and misrepresentation penalties.

headings.title: Use of non-English policy documents and disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Permits non-English policy materials, making English controlling and requiring bilingual informational disclosures.

headings.title: Unfair trade practice penalty for misrepresentation
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowing misrepresentation in non-English policy materials as an unfair trade practice.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires insurer address and phone number in contracts, thirty-day written notice of address changes, and unfair trade penalties.

headings.title: Insurer address and telephone number in contracts
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers and HMOs to include principal business address and phone number in all policies.

headings.title: Thirty days notice of address change to insureds
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice of address or phone changes to covered persons within thirty days of change.

headings.title: Unfair trade practice penalties for address violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies failure to provide contact information or change notices as an unfair trade practice.

headings.title: Effective date for unfair trade practice penalties
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that unfair trade practice penalty provisions took effect on July 1, 1993.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets short title of Unfair Trade Practice Act, purpose under McCarran-Ferguson Act, and disclaims private causes of action.

headings.title: Citation of unfair trade practice act
headings.reviewNote: Cites sections 375.930 to 375.948 as the Unfair Trade Practice Act.

headings.title: Statutory purpose and disclaimer of private action
headings.reviewNote: Regulates trade practices under Public Law 15 and disclaims creation of private causes of action.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits lending tie-ins with specific insurance providers, unreasonable contract rejections, service fees, and information misuse.

headings.title: Prohibition on insurance tie-ins with lending
headings.reviewNote: Bars lenders from conditioning credit extension on borrower purchasing insurance through designated insurer or producer.

headings.title: Prohibited lender practices regarding borrower insurance
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unreasonable rejection of borrower contracts, charging substitution fees, or misusing borrower policy data.

headings.title: Written notice of free insurer choice and loan commitment
headings.reviewNote: Requires lenders soliciting property insurance to explain in writing the borrower's right to choose an insurer or agent (subject to subsection 2(1)), recognizes Truth-in-Lending disclosures, and governs loan commitment terms.

headings.title: Director examination, investigation, and complaint authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to examine and investigate insurance-related activities of any person potentially violating this section and allows affected persons to submit complaints.

headings.title: Lender right to place insurance on borrower default
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that lenders may place insurance on real or personal property if the borrower fails to provide required insurance under the loan or credit document.

headings.title: Exemption for credit life and accident-health insurance
headings.reviewNote: Excludes credit life and credit accident and health insurance from the provisions of this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes director administrative cease and desist orders, level two penalties, license revocation, and civil court actions.

headings.title: Administrative orders level two penalties and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director administrative orders under section 374.046, level two violation penalties, and license revocation.

headings.title: Civil injunctive actions for unfair trade practices
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to maintain civil action under section 374.048 for unfair trade practice violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs judicial review of unfair trade practice orders, court decrees, additional evidence remand, and order finality.

headings.title: Judicial review of director cease and desist orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides for judicial review of director orders under chapter 536 in Cole County circuit court.

headings.title: Court decree, enforcement order, and additional evidence
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the court to affirm, modify, or reverse director orders, issue enforcement commands upon affirmation, and order the director to take additional material evidence on good cause and file modified findings.

headings.title: Finality of section 375.942 director orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a section 375.942 order becomes final upon expiration of the review period without petition (subject to section 375.942(2) modification) or upon final court affirmation or dismissal.

headings.title: Preservation of liability under other state laws
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that no director order under section 375.942 or court enforcement order relieves any affected person from liability under other Missouri laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Grants complainants thirty-day judicial review when the director declines to institute unfair-practice proceedings or issues a post-hearing report finding no violation, with court injunction and penalty authority.

headings.title: Judicial review of director refusal to institute proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Grants complainants 30-day judicial review under section 536.140 when the director determines a section 375.940 proceeding on a section 375.936 or 375.937 complaint is not in the public interest, allowing the court to order proceedings and additional evidence.

headings.title: Judicial review of post-hearing report charging no violation
headings.reviewNote: Grants complainants 30-day review in Cole County circuit court under sections 536.100 to 536.140 when a director report after hearing does not charge a section 375.936 or 375.937 violation, with court injunction and section 375.942 penalty powers.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes cumulative regulatory powers and administrative rulemaking authority for unfair trade practice enforcement.

headings.title: Cumulative regulatory powers of insurance director
headings.reviewNote: Declares that statutory powers are in addition to other regulatory authority and remedies under state law.

headings.title: Promulgation of unfair trade practice rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to adopt administrative rules and regulations under chapter 536 to enforce trade practices.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines key statutory terms for the Uniform Insurers Liquidation Act and multi-state insolvency administration.

headings.title: Citation of Uniform Insurer's Liquidation Act
headings.reviewNote: Provides that sections 375.950 to 375.990 may be cited as the Uniform Insurer's Liquidation Act.

headings.title: Applicability limited to pre-August 28, 1991 proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Restricts sections 375.950 to 375.990 strictly to proceedings instituted prior to August 28, 1991.

headings.title: Definitions for Uniform Insurer's Liquidation Act
headings.reviewNote: Defines twelve terms including ancillary state, delinquency proceeding, domiciliary state, general assets, insurer, preferred claim, receiver, reciprocal state, secured claim, and special deposit claim.

entries.reviewSummary: Appoints director as domiciliary receiver, vests title to assets, imparts notice, and regulates special deputy appointments.

headings.title: Appointment of director as domiciliary receiver
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to appoint director as receiver with title to all property, contracts, books, and records.

headings.title: Constructive notice from recording liquidation order
headings.reviewNote: Provides that recording liquidation order with county recorder of deeds imparts same notice as recorded deed.

headings.title: Appointment and powers of special deputy receivers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes receiver to appoint special deputies and counsel with compensation paid from insurer assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs appointment of director as ancillary receiver for foreign insurers, title to local assets, and transfer to domiciliary receiver.

headings.title: Appointment of director as ancillary receiver
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to appoint director as ancillary receiver if sufficient assets exist in Missouri to justify appointment.

headings.title: Title to Missouri assets and transfer to domicile
headings.reviewNote: Vests ancillary receiver with asset title, directs liquidation of special deposits, and transfers remaining assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs claim filing options for reciprocal state claimants against Missouri insurers and conclusive effect of ancillary judgments.

headings.title: Claim filing options for reciprocal state claimants
headings.reviewNote: Permits claimants in reciprocal states to file claims with ancillary receiver or domiciliary receiver.

headings.title: Conclusive effect of ancillary state claim allowances
headings.reviewNote: Accepts ancillary court claim allowances as conclusive regarding amount and priority against local special deposits.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates claim filing by Missouri residents against foreign insurers in reciprocal states and ancillary court proof.

headings.title: Claim filing options for Missouri residents
headings.reviewNote: Allows Missouri claimants against foreign insurers to file either with Missouri ancillary receiver or domiciliary receiver.

headings.title: Proving claims before Missouri ancillary receiver
headings.reviewNote: Establishes procedure for proving claims in Missouri ancillary proceeding and conclusive effect on Missouri deposits.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes equal priority of preferred claims across reciprocal states and limits recognition of foreign statutory preferences.

headings.title: Equal priority of preferred claims from general assets
headings.reviewNote: Accords preferred status to reciprocal claims if like claims are preferred in Missouri, giving equal general asset priority.

headings.title: Preferred claims in reciprocal state proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Gives Missouri residents preferred claim status in reciprocal state delinquency if preferred by that state law.

entries.reviewSummary: Protects Federal Home Loan Bank rights regarding pledged collateral, stock repurchase, receiver timelines, and transfer avoidance.

headings.title: Definitions for federal home loan bank proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Defines federal home loan bank and insurer-member for delinquency proceeding rights.

headings.title: Protection of bank rights in pledged collateral
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits staying or enjoining Federal Home Loan Bank from exercising rights regarding pledged collateral.

headings.title: Repurchase of excess capital stock by bank
headings.reviewNote: Directs bank to repurchase outstanding capital stock exceeding minimum investment upon collateral exercise.

headings.title: Ten-day timeline for bank collateral release process
headings.reviewNote: Requires bank within ten business days to establish process for releasing excess collateral and lending info.

headings.title: Options to renew or restructure loans on receiver request
headings.reviewNote: Requires a Federal Home Loan Bank, upon receiver request, to provide available options for a delinquent insurer-member to renew or restructure loans to defer prepayment fees subject to market, loan, policy, and federal rules.

headings.title: Bar on avoiding ordinary-course bank security transfers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a receiver from voiding ordinary-course transfers or security agreements with a Federal Home Loan Bank unless made with intent to hinder, delay, or defraud, preserving receiver advance rights under 12 CFR 1266.4.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes statutory severability and uniform construction mandate for the Uniform Insurers Liquidation Act.

headings.title: Statutory severability of uniform liquidation provisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that invalidity of any provision shall not affect other valid sections of the uniform act.

headings.title: Uniform statutory construction with other states
headings.reviewNote: Mandates interpretation to effectuate general purpose of making uniform the laws of enacting states.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines statement and fraudulent insurance acts including false medical billing practices, authorizes department investigations and criminal referrals, imposes class E and class D felony penalties, and mandates restitution.

headings.title: Definition of statement for insurance fraud statutes
headings.reviewNote: Defines statement for sections 375.991 to 375.994 to include communications, proofs of loss, invoices, damage estimates, medical records, x-rays, test results, and other evidence of loss or expense.

headings.title: Definition of fraudulent insurance act
headings.reviewNote: Defines fraudulent insurance act as knowingly presenting, preparing, or concealing materially false information in oral, written, or computer-generated statements supporting commercial or personal policy applications, ratings, or claims.

headings.title: False medical billing practices constituting fraud
headings.reviewNote: Includes unbundling, upcoding, exploding, and duplicating medical or health claims as fraudulent insurance acts while preserving good-faith coding efforts.

headings.title: Department oaths, subpoenas, and criminal referrals
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to administer oaths, serve subpoenas, and collect evidence on suspected fraud or chapters 375 to 385 violations, and lets the director refer evidence to prosecuting or circuit attorneys.

headings.title: Out-of-state inspections and interstate cooperation
headings.reviewNote: Allows inspecting out-of-state requested materials where located, designating out-of-state representatives or officials, and responding to similar requests from other states.

headings.title: Class E and class D felony penalties
headings.reviewNote: Makes a first fraudulent insurance act a class E felony and any subsequent offense by a previously convicted offender a class D felony.

headings.title: Mandatory court-ordered restitution to victims
headings.reviewNote: Requires the court to order any person pleading or found guilty of a fraudulent insurance act to make restitution to any person or insurer for resulting financial loss.

headings.title: Preservation of criminal prosecution under general law
headings.reviewNote: Preserves state power to prosecute fraud and stealing under general state criminal statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Protects confidentiality of insurance fraud investigation records and grants civil immunity for reporting suspected fraud.

headings.title: Confidentiality of fraud investigation papers and evidence
headings.reviewNote: Exempts fraud investigation files and evidence from public inspection, discovery, and subpoena.

headings.title: Civil immunity for furnishing fraud information
headings.reviewNote: Grants immunity from civil liability for communicating suspected fraud to department or law enforcement.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes investigator subpoenas, deposit of recoveries into dedicated fund, administrative orders, and unfair trade remedies.

headings.title: Subpoena powers of department fraud investigators
headings.reviewNote: Empowers fraud investigators to issue subpoenas, compel witness attendance, and examine books and records.

headings.title: Prohibition on interfering with department investigators
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to interfere with, or abet or assist resistance to, department investigators performing duties imposed by law or department rule.

headings.title: Deposit of recoveries in insurance dedicated fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs deposit of collected investigation costs, fines, and recoveries into the insurance dedicated fund.

headings.title: Administrative orders and level two violation penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies violations as level two.

headings.title: Civil actions for fraudulent insurance violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to maintain civil action under section 374.048 for fraudulent insurance conduct.

headings.title: Regulation under unfair trade practices act
headings.reviewNote: Preserves department authority to regulate unfair or fraudulent trade practices under sections 375.930 to 375.948.

headings.title: Unfair claims settlement practice classification for fraud
headings.reviewNote: Classifies business fraud as unfair trade practice or unfair claims settlement practice.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits insurance benefit and coverage discrimination based on sex or marital status, listing specific prohibited practices.

headings.title: Definitions for sex and marital status nondiscrimination
headings.reviewNote: Defines contract and insurer for sex and marital status nondiscrimination provisions.

headings.title: Purpose to eliminate sex and marital status discrimination
headings.reviewNote: States legislative purpose to eliminate denying benefits or coverage solely on sex or marital status.

headings.title: Applicability to post-enactment and amended contracts
headings.reviewNote: Applies section to contracts issued on or after October 1, 1986, and amended existing group policies.

headings.title: Prohibited discriminatory practices in policy benefits
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates prohibited practices including denying female disability coverage, rider exclusions, and maternity rules.
